```
# CLARA Care Fluent Experience Redesign

Status: implementation baseline  
Date: 2026-07-22  
Scope: CLARA Web public, patient, clinical, research, and administration surfaces

## 1. Product intent

CLARA should feel calm, credible, and task-oriented. The interface must help a person understand what needs attention, what CLARA knows, what remains uncertain, and what action is safe to take next. It must not resemble a trading terminal, imply diagnosis through decoration, or expose internal telemetry as primary patient content.

The visual direction follows Fluent 2 principles: semantic tokens, neutral layered surfaces, restrained brand use, a 4 px spacing grid, Segoe UI typography, clear state changes, and accessible platform-native interaction. “Fluent-inspired” means the system follows these rules without forcing a risky whole-application dependency migration.

## 2. Research and audit findings

The existing product contains three competing visual systems: a blue glass shell, cyan “futuristic” dashboard/research surfaces, and a more restrained chat workspace. The inconsistency is structural rather than a lack of polish. Large feature pages also combine data loading, workflow state, and presentation, so a shared foundation has the highest immediate reach with the lowest behavior risk.

Research sources:

- [Fluent 2 design tokens](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/design-tokens)
- [Fluent 2 color](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/color)
- [Fluent 2 layout](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/layout)
- [Fluent 2 typography](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/typography)
- [Fluent 2 accessibility](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/accessibility)
- [WCAG 2 overview](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/glance/)
- [AHRQ health-literacy universal precautions](https://www.ahrq.gov/health-literacy/improve/precautions/index.html)
- [ONC patient engagement playbook](https://playbook.healthit.gov/playbook/pe/chapter-3/)

## 3. Users and jobs

### Patient and caregiver

- Ask a health question and understand the answer, evidence, uncertainty, and next safe action.
- Maintain a health record and medicine cabinet without losing entered data.
- Recognize urgent safety guidance separately from routine information.
- Review medicine interactions with plain-language explanations and provenance.

### Clinician

- Capture a visit, review a structured note, and confirm before export.
- Start and follow a council case through intake, analysis, evidence, and result.
- Move between a central work canvas and contextual evidence without losing state.

### Researcher and administrator

- Run research at the intended depth and see progress, sources, and verification.
- Find operational exceptions quickly, then disclose detail progressively.
- Configure sources and workflows without mixing destructive actions into routine views.

## 4. Functional requirements

1. The authenticated product uses one responsive app shell with persistent desktop navigation, a compact rail, and a modal mobile drawer.
2. Navigation selection is conveyed by text, icon treatment, and a visible indicator—not color alone.
3. Every page has a consistent title region, optional description/context, primary action position, and content width.
4. Patient and clinical pages order content as: next action, safety/attention, summary, detail, provenance.
5. Workspaces use a command region, central canvas, and optional contextual rail. Secondary controls use progressive disclosure.
6. Status includes a label/icon and, where relevant, timestamp, source, owner, and next action.
7. Loading, empty, error, stale/offline, permission-denied, and completed states are visually and semantically distinct.
8. Consequential medication, consent, sharing, and deletion actions name the object, action, and consequence before confirmation.
9. Input values survive recoverable failures. Validation is adjacent to the field and announced to assistive technology.
10. Light, dark, forced-color, reduced-motion, Vietnamese, and English preferences remain supported.

## 5. Design system

### Tokens

Use global primitives only to construct semantic aliases. Components consume aliases such as canvas, surface 1–3, foreground 1–3, neutral stroke, brand background/foreground, status background/foreground, control rest/hover/pressed, shadow, radius, and motion. Raw status colors must not carry clinical meaning by themselves.

### Layout

- Base spacing unit: 4 px.
- Control/internal spacing: 4, 8, 12, 16 px.
- Group/section spacing: 20, 24, 32, 40, 48 px.
- Minimum interactive target: 44 × 44 px.
- Standard content maximum: 1,440 px; immersive workspaces may use available width.
- Cards use 8–12 px radii. Pills are reserved for compact tags and statuses.

### Typography

Segoe UI is primary, followed by native system fonts. Default body is 14/20 or 16/24. Captions never fall below 12/16 for meaningful content. Page titles use 28–32 px with semibold weight. Labels use sentence case and remain visible; placeholders are examples, never labels.

### Color and elevation

Neutral surfaces establish hierarchy. Brand blue is used for identity, selection, links, and the primary action. Success, warning, and danger colors are reserved for real states. Most regions use a stroke or a low elevation; dialogs/drawers use higher elevation. Decorative glow, glass blur, dot grids, and perpetual pulses are removed from authenticated workflows.

### Motion

Micro-interactions use 100–200 ms; panels use 200–300 ms. Animate opacity and transform only when it clarifies state. `prefers-reduced-motion` disables nonessential animation and smooth scrolling.

## 6. Information architecture

- Core: Chat, Overview, Personal Health Record, Community.
- Medication: Medicine Cabinet, Interaction Check.
- Research: Source Hub and evidence tools for permitted roles.
- Clinical: Council and Medical Scribe for clinicians/admins.
- Administration: overview first, then knowledge, answer flow, observability, moderation, and analytics.

Desktop presents these as labeled navigation groups. Mobile keeps a small bottom set for frequent destinations and uses the drawer for the complete hierarchy. Account, theme, language, help, and sign-out are separated from product destinations.

## 7. Accessibility requirements

- WCAG 2.2 AA target: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and UI boundaries.
- Keyboard access for every action, visible 2 px focus indicator, logical DOM order, skip link, and focus restoration.
- Closed dialogs/drawers are absent from the accessibility tree; open modal surfaces trap focus and close with Escape where safe.
- Reflow at 320 CSS px / 400% zoom and text resize to 200% without lost content.
- Status never uses color alone. Icon-only controls have accessible names.
- Tables retain header associations; charts provide a textual summary and accessible data alternative.
- Live loading/streaming/error changes use appropriate live regions without excessive announcements.

## 8. Technical design

The first implementation layer keeps application behavior intact and changes presentation through:

1. A semantic token contract in `styles/globals.css` for light/dark themes.
2. Shared page and surface primitives under `components/ui`.
3. A unified `AppShell`, navigation rail/drawer, mobile command bar, and bottom navigation.
4. Compatibility mappings for legacy `chrome`, `glass`, research, dashboard, and feature-panel classes so every route adopts the new system immediately.
5. Incremental page decomposition after the shared foundation, starting with safety-sensitive patient workflows, without changing API contracts.

No medical guardrail, RBAC, consent, emergency fast-path, citation, verification, or telemetry-sanitization behavior may be weakened by visual work.

## 9. Responsive behavior

- Mobile (320–767): single content column, 16 px gutters, top command bar, compact bottom navigation, full-height modal drawer.
- Tablet (768–1023): wider single column or two-pane workspaces where content permits.
- Desktop (1024+): persistent navigation, responsive canvas, optional contextual rail.
- Very wide screens: content remains readable; dashboards may expand grids while prose maintains line length.

## 10. Verification and definition of done

- Unit/component tests pass.
- ESLint, TypeScript production build, design-token, contrast, and focus checks pass.
- Primary routes are checked at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths in light and dark modes.
- Keyboard-only navigation, reduced motion, loading/error states, and public/auth scrolling are manually checked.
- No unrelated files or secrets are committed.
- Deployment uses a rollback-tagged frontend image, local and public health checks, route smokes, and log inspection.

## 11. Delivery sequence

1. Foundation and responsive shell.
2. Shared surfaces, controls, and state patterns.
3. Patient workflows: PHR, medicine cabinet, CareGuard, community.
4. Research, council, and scribe workspaces.
5. Dashboard and administration density/table patterns.
6. Public, auth, help, and legal refinement.
7. Remove legacy styles/components only after route parity and visual baselines exist.


```

```
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL),
  title: {
    default: "The Clara Care",
    template: "%s | The Clara Care",
  },
  description: "The Clara Care - trợ lý AI y tế cho research, hội chẩn tham khảo và an toàn thuốc.",

    title: "The Clara Care",
    description: "Clinical Agent for Retrieval & Analysis",
    url: SITE_URL,
    siteName: "The Clara Care",
    locale: "vi_VN",
    type: "website",
  },
  alternates: {
    canonical: SITE_URL,
  },
};

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="vi" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark" />
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/font-awesome/4.7.0/css/font-awesome.min.css" />
        <link
          rel="stylesheet"
          href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@24,400,0,0&display=swap"
        />
        <script id="theme-init" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: getThemeInitScript() }} />
      </head>
      <body>
        <AnalyticsConsentBootstrap />
        <AppShell>{children}</AppShell>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

```
 * Compatibility layer for feature surfaces that predate the shared Fluent

 */
.clara-glass-panel,
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1,
.glass-surface-2,
.glass-surface-3,
.chrome-panel,
.research-panel-modern,
.dashboard-holo-panel,
.dashboard-strip-panel,
.dashboard-side-panel {

  background: var(--surface-panel);

  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

.chrome-shell::before,

html.dark,
html[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;

  --status-warn-bg: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.22);

  --status-danger-bg: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.22);

  --status-neutral-bg: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 28rem at 82% -10%,
      rgb(37 137 202 / 8%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, var(--bg-canvas) 32rem);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-feature-settings:
    "rlig" 1,
    "calt" 1;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {

}

::selection {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgb(37 99 235 / 80%);
}

a {

}

.material-symbols-outlined {

.clara-glass-panel {

}

.glow-cyan {

}

.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

.hide-scrollbar {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {

  height: 4px;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {

}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

.clara-chat-workspace {

  );

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-workspace {

  --shell-border-strong: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.48);
  --text-primary: #e6edff;
  --text-secondary: #c4d1ea;
  --text-muted: #91a0ba;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      68rem 34rem at 100% -12%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      46rem 26rem at 0% 108%,
      rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.08),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #081225 0%, #091326 48%, #0d1629 100%);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace .clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,

  .clara-chat-workspace

  background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.38);
}

/*
 * CHAT_V2 (clara-chat-redesign, task 7.1) — WCAG AA contrast hardening.
 *
 * The v2 shell reuses the root design tokens. In dark mode the root
 * `--text-muted` (#8d919a) lands at ~4.0:1 against the v2 `--surface-muted`
 * panels — below the AA 4.5:1 threshold for the small (10–11px) uppercase
 * labels that use it. Scope a slightly lighter muted to the v2 surface only so
 * the audit passes without altering the legacy chat or the rest of the app.
 * All other v2 token pairs (primary/secondary/brand/status text on their
 * backgrounds, both themes) already clear AA.
 */
html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  --text-muted: #9aa7be;
}

.clara-chat-v2 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 24rem at 82% -8%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 7%),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    var(--bg-canvas);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
}

/* Compat classes */
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1 {

  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    var(--glass-highlight),
    var(--glass-fill)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm)) saturate(130%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.glass-surface-2 {
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke);
  background: linear-gradient(
    165deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.44),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)) saturate(140%);

}

.glass-surface-3 {
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
  background: linear-gradient(
    170deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.54)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg)) saturate(150%);

}

.chrome-shell {

}

.chrome-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 25rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(14 165 233 / 14%),
      transparent 64%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      40rem 18rem at 0% 16%,
      rgb(13 148 136 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 40%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 8%) 1px,

}

    );

}

html.dark .chrome-panel,

    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(10, 18, 35, 0.88), rgba(8, 14, 28, 0.9)),

    );
}

.chrome-nav-link {

@media (hover: hover) {

  }
}

}

.research-workspace::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 20rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 13%),

    ),
    radial-gradient(
      36rem 16rem at 6% 96%,
      rgb(96 165 250 / 11%),
      transparent 70%
    ),

}

.research-workspace > * {
  position: relative;

.research-panel-modern {
  border: 1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 32%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 82%), rgb(255 255 255 / 66%)),
    radial-gradient(120% 95% at 96% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 12%), transparent 58%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(135%);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 55px -36px rgb(2 132 199 / 44%);
}

html.dark .research-panel-modern,

  background:
    linear-gradient(166deg, rgb(9 16 31 / 82%), rgb(8 14 28 / 78%)),

  box-shadow: 0 24px 56px -34px rgb(2 6 23 / 86%);

.research-chip {

html[data-theme="dark"] .research-chip {

.research-chip-cyan {

.research-hero-heading {

    118deg,
    #9eefff 0%,

  );

  position: relative;

    linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(8 47 73 / 35%), rgb(15 23 42 / 62%));
}

.research-live-engine::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    rgb(148 163 184 / 10%) 1px,

  );
  background-size: 18px 100%;
}

.research-live-bars {

  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  height: 100%;

  z-index: 1;

  );

}

.research-pulse-dot {

}

@keyframes research-pulse-dot {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(34 211 238 / 55%);
  }
  65% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 0%);
  }
  100% {

  }
}

.med-gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--brand-500), var(--accent-500) 72%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/*
 * Accessibility: visible keyboard focus indicator (Requirement 5.4).
 *
 * A single token-driven focus ring is applied to every interactive control,
 * including custom-role widgets. We draw a real `outline` (not just a
 * box-shadow) so the indicator survives Windows High Contrast / forced-colors
 * mode, and layer the soft brand glow on top for the default theme. Focus is
 * only shown for keyboard interaction via `:focus-visible`, so pointer users
 * are not distracted by rings.
 */
:is(
  a[href],
  button,
  input,
  textarea,
  select,
  summary,
  [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
  [contenteditable="true"],
  [role="button"],
  [role="link"],
  [role="tab"],
  [role="menuitem"],
  [role="menuitemcheckbox"],
  [role="menuitemradio"],
  [role="option"],
  [role="switch"],
  [role="checkbox"],
  [role="radio"]
):focus-visible,
.focus-ring:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
}

/* In forced-colors mode the soft glow is dropped; keep the system-drawn ring. */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :is(
    a[href],
    button,
    input,
    textarea,
    select,
    summary,
    [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
    [contenteditable="true"],
    [role="button"],
    [role="link"],
    [role="tab"],
    [role="menuitem"],
    [role="option"],
    [role="switch"],
    [role="checkbox"],
    [role="radio"]
  ):focus-visible,
  .focus-ring:focus-visible {
    outline-color: Highlight;
  }
}

/*
 * Skip link: the first focusable element in the app shell so keyboard users can
 * jump straight to the main content, keeping a logical tab order (Requirement 5.4).
 * It is visually hidden until focused.
 */
.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0.75rem;
  left: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 100;
  transform: translateY(-180%);
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

.skip-link:focus,
.skip-link:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .skip-link {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@layer components {
  .input {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
    transition:
      border-color 0.15s ease,
      box-shadow 0.15s ease,
      background-color 0.15s ease;
  }
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

.input:hover:not(:disabled):not(:focus) {
  border-color: var(--brand-500);
}

.input:focus,
.input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--brand-600);
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);
}

.input:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background-color: var(--surface-muted);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

html.dark .input,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.7);
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html.dark .input::placeholder,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input::placeholder {
  color: #94a3b8;
}

html.dark .input:focus,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus,
html.dark .input:focus-visible,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus-visible {
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

html.dark body,
html[data-theme="dark"] body {
  background-image: none;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-white,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-white {
  background-color: rgba(12, 20, 36, 0.9) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50 {
  background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.58) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .border-slate-200,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .border-slate-200 {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.62) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-900,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-900 {
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-800,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-800 {
  color: #dbe7f6 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-700,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-700 {
  color: #cdd8ea !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-600,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-600 {
  color: #b2bfd4 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-500,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-500 {
  color: #8ea0bc !important;
}

/* CLARA landing inspired by KP3 */
.clara-shell {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  --clara-motion-fast: 160ms;
  --clara-motion-base: 220ms;
  --clara-motion-slow: 360ms;
  --clara-motion-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      74rem 42rem at 50% -24%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18) 36%,
      transparent 76%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 48%,
      rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.08) 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #010611 0%, #010916 26%, #031231 58%, #020a1d 100%);
  background-size:
    auto,
    16px 16px,
    auto;
}

.clara-shell::before,
.clara-shell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.clara-shell::before {
  inset: -32% 54% auto -16%;
  height: 52rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  filter: blur(6px);
}

.clara-shell::after {
  inset: auto -22% -38% 55%;
  height: 46rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
}

.clara-ambient-layers {
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      30rem 16rem at 15% 28%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18),
      transparent 68%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      34rem 18rem at 84% 18%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      20rem 12rem at 70% 66%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
      transparent 68%
    );
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  animation: clara-ambient-shift 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes clara-ambient-shift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(0, -1.8%, 0) scale(1.03);
  }
}

.clara-grid-overlay {
  z-index: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(66% 56% at 50% 26%, #000 36%, transparent 100%);
  animation: clara-grid-drift 22s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes clara-grid-drift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(16px, 16px, 0);
  }
}

.clara-nav-frame {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.42) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    150deg,
    rgba(6, 18, 45, 0.9),
    rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.94)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 24px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 32px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
}

.clara-nav-link {
  transition:
    color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    background-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    border-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-nav-link:hover {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.5);
  color: #d9f6ff;
  background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.28);
}

.clara-wave-top::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 6%;
  right: 6%;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: clamp(20px, 2vw, 34px);
  border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    70% 140% at 50% 100%,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28),
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-panel {
  isolation: isolate;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      90% 74% at 50% -4%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.34),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 36%,
      rgba(8, 20, 49, 0.92) 72%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.96) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 22, 1) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 48px 110px -62px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.82);
}

.clara-hero-panel::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 8% 3% 8%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.6),
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-constellation {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 9% 7% auto 7%;
  height: 14rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.clara-const-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.6rem;
  height: 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 35%,
    #f0fdff 12%,
    #60a5fa 66%,
    #2563eb 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-const-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 26%;
}
.clara-const-node-b {
  left: 28%;
  top: 12%;
}
.clara-const-node-c {
  right: 20%;
  top: 18%;
}
.clara-const-node-d {
  right: 7%;
  top: 34%;
}

.clara-const-link {
  position: absolute;
  height: 1px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.8),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0)
  );
}

.clara-const-link-a {
  left: 8.4%;
  top: 28.4%;
  width: 24%;
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
}

.clara-const-link-b {
  left: 30.2%;
  top: 14%;
  width: 44%;
  transform: rotate(5deg);
}

.clara-dome-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      116% 92% at 50% -6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.48),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) 34%,
      rgba(8, 16, 38, 0.95) 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.99), rgba(4, 10, 26, 1));
}

.clara-dark-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      92% 80% at 50% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.19),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 18, 42, 0.93), rgba(5, 12, 28, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.08),
    0 30px 58px -40px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92);
}

.clara-model-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      76% 68% at 50% 6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.22),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 40%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 23, 53, 0.97), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
    0 30px 60px -44px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.7);
  min-height: 360px;
}

.clara-glass-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.34) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 0% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.16),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(8, 24, 55, 0.86), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.88)) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 26px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-kpi-card {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-card-equal {
  min-height: 430px;
}

.clara-stat-card {
  min-height: 168px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-dark-card,
.clara-model-card {
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .clara-dark-card:hover,
  .clara-model-card:hover,
  .clara-kpi-card:hover,
  .clara-stat-card:hover,
  .clara-glass-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
      0 34px 62px -38px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.66),
      0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
  }
}

.clara-neon-button {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.56);
  background: linear-gradient(98deg, #183dbd 0%, #1f58d6 46%, #09649f 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.26),
    0 14px 36px -18px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 28px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    filter var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.4);
}

.clara-neon-button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -110% auto -110% -42%;
  width: 34%;
  transform: rotate(15deg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)
  );
  opacity: 0.45;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-slow) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    opacity var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    0 20px 44px -20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 34px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(350%) rotate(15deg);
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.clara-neon-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.clara-display-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 11.2vw, 9rem);
  line-height: 0.97;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 26px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.3),
    0 3px 16px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.62);
}

.clara-sub-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6.4vw, 5.85rem);
  line-height: 1.03;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.58);
}

/* Futuristic dashboard utilities */
.futura-panel {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 82%, #60a5fa 18%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(56 189 248 / 10%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(120% 84% at 0% 100%, rgb(16 185 129 / 7%), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 94%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 88%, transparent)
    );
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(118%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 22%),
    0 14px 30px -28px rgb(2 132 199 / 36%);
}

.futura-panel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 18px 18px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(80% 65% at 50% 15%, #000 30%, transparent 100%);
  opacity: 0.46;
}

.futura-card {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 84%, #60a5fa 16%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 8%), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(
      170deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 90%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -20px rgb(15 23 42 / 22%);
}

.futura-kpi {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 86%, #60a5fa 14%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 92%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -16px rgb(15 23 42 / 18%);
}

.futura-chip {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 68%, #60a5fa 32%);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 84%, transparent);
}

html.dark .futura-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .futura-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 12%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 0% 100%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(6 12 24 / 90%), rgb(4 10 20 / 92%));
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .futura-card:hover,
  .futura-kpi:hover,
  .futura-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 20%),
      0 14px 26px -20px rgb(14 165 233 / 28%),
      0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 14%);
  }
}

.clara-copy-rhythm {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.45vw + 0.93rem, 1.16rem);
  line-height: clamp(1.78rem, 0.75vw + 1.6rem, 2.12rem);
}

.clara-cta-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.44);
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    rgba(8, 21, 48, 0.8),
    rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.86)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 26px 64px -44px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9),
    0 0 26px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-cta-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.clara-cta-stack > .clara-neon-button {
  width: min(100%, 23.5rem);
}

.clara-final-cta-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      112% 82% at 50% -12%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16) 45%,
      rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.96) 74%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.98), rgba(4, 14, 34, 1));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
    0 40px 90px -58px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.94);
}

.clara-medical-band {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 28rem at 12% 6%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.24),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      52rem 24rem at 88% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.26),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #051127 0%, #041028 54%, #05152f 100%);
}

.clara-medical-band-soft {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 30rem at 78% -8%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      42rem 20rem at 16% 100%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #041028 0%, #041128 100%);
}

.clara-medical-panel,
.clara-medical-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(6, 20, 48, 0.88), rgba(3, 12, 30, 0.92)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 55%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 30px 62px -42px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.58);
}

.clara-med-heading {
  color: #f8fcff;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.22),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-copy {
  color: #cbd5e1;
  max-width: 62ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.clara-med-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.46),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16)
  );
  color: #d0f2ff;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.clara-rating-pill {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.35);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.34),
    rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.46)
  );
  padding: 0.36rem 0.72rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: rgba(219, 234, 254, 0.95);
}

.clara-star-icon {
  color: #93c5fd;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.35));
}

.clara-play-button {
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-play-button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -0.65rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35);
  animation: clara-pulse-ring 2.2s ease-out infinite;
  z-index: -1;
}

@keyframes clara-pulse-ring {

  }
  70% {

  100% {

  }
}

.clara-medical-bullet {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.5rem;
}

.clara-medical-bullet::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;

    linear-gradient(
      90deg,

    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      transparent 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 42%,

    ),
    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.26), rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12));

}

.clara-medical-visual {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(13rem, 28vw, 20rem);

}

.clara-med-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 21%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 34% 28%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.55) 35%,
    rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.86) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:

}

.clara-med-ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-ring-a {
  inset: 9%;
  transform: rotate(10deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-a 16s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-ring-b {
  inset: 3%;
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.34);
  transform: rotate(-16deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-b 20s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-cross {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18%;
  right: 11%;
  width: 2.55rem;
  height: 2.55rem;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    rgba(14, 116, 255, 0.96),

  );

}

.clara-med-cross::before,
.clara-med-cross::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
}

.clara-med-cross::before {
  top: 50%;
  left: 24%;
  right: 24%;
  height: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-cross::after {
  left: 50%;
  top: 24%;
  bottom: 24%;
  width: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.72rem;
  height: 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.4);
}

.clara-med-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 39%;
}

.clara-med-node-b {
  right: 6%;
  top: 45%;
}

.clara-med-node-c {
  left: 24%;
  bottom: 6%;
}

.clara-med-node-d {
  right: 20%;
  bottom: 11%;
}

.clara-data-orbit {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(5.6rem, 14vw, 7.4rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  animation: clara-orbit-breathe 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.clara-data-orbit-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 24%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 30%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.94) 70%,
    rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.98)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 42%;
  height: 2px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.88)
  );
}

.clara-data-orbit-link::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -0.35rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0.66rem;
  height: 0.66rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.42);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-a {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(20deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-b {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(138deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-c {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(264deg);
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-a {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(10deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(370deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-b {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(-16deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(-376deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-breathe {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
}

html.dark .clara-medical-panel,
html.dark .clara-medical-card,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-card {

    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(5, 16, 38, 0.9), rgba(3, 10, 24, 0.94)),

      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22),
      transparent 55%
    );
}

.clara-section,
.clara-section-strong {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-section::before,
.clara-section-strong::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(92%, 1320px);
  height: 1px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 20%,
    rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.62) 50%,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 80%,
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section::after,
.clara-section-strong::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(82%, 1040px);
  height: 24px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -60%);
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 4.7vw, 7.1rem);
}

.clara-section-strong {
  padding-block: clamp(3.6rem, 5.7vw, 8.2rem);
}

.clara-neon-text {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    #ffffff 0%,
    #e6f8ff 24%,
    #b3edff 48%,
    #93c5fd 76%,
    #60a5fa 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.66),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.5);
}

.dashboard-atmosphere {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.dashboard-atmosphere::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6rem -2rem auto -2rem;
  height: 17rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(

}

  content: "";

  background:
    radial-gradient(

      circle at 76% 72%,

  z-index: -1;

}

.dashboard-fade-up {

.dashboard-strip-panel {

.dashboard-live-pill::before {

  width: 0.45rem;

    transform: translateY(0);
  }

}

}

  -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
}
```

```
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --workspace-gutter: 1.125rem;
  --workspace-gutter-lg: 1.75rem;
  --workspace-gutter-2xl: 2.25rem;
  --touch-target-min: 44px;
  --shell-nav-width: 17rem;

  /* Foundation */
  --color-bg: #f7f8fb;
  --bg-canvas: #f7f8fb;
  --bg-elev-1: #ffffff;
  --bg-elev-2: #ffffff;
  --bg-elev-3: #ffffff;

  /* Text */
  --text-primary: #18212f;
  --text-secondary: #46556a;
  --text-muted: #5b6a80;
  --text-brand: #1d4ed8;

  /* Shell surfaces */
  --surface-sidebar: #f9fafc;
  --surface-header: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  --surface-panel: #ffffff;
  --surface-muted: #f1f4f8;
  --surface-brand-soft: #edf3ff;
  --shell-border: #e2e7ef;
  --shell-border-strong: #9aabc0;

  /* Brand + status */
  --brand-500: #3b82f6;
  --brand-600: #2563eb;
  --brand-700: #1d4ed8;
  --accent-500: #5b5fc7;
  --success-500: #16a34a;
  --warn-500: #f59e0b;
  --danger-500: #dc2626;
  --status-ok-bg: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.14);
  --status-ok-border: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.36);
  --status-ok-text: #046b4d;
  --status-warn-bg: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.14);
  --status-warn-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.34);
  --status-warn-text: #92400e;
  --status-danger-bg: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.14);
  --status-danger-border: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.34);
  --status-danger-text: #b91c1c;
  --status-neutral-bg: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12);
  --status-neutral-border: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.32);
  --status-neutral-text: #334155;
  --dashboard-accent-soft: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14);
  --dashboard-side-panel-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);

  /* Glass */
  --glass-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
  --glass-stroke: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.26);
  --glass-highlight: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
  --blur-sm: 8px;
  --blur-md: 14px;
  --blur-lg: 24px;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
  --radius-xl: 20px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-soft: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-float: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-hero: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28);
  --shadow-chrome: 0 20px 54px -34px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);

  /* Focus ring (Requirement 5.4) — defined once, reused everywhere */
  --focus-ring-color: var(--brand-700);
  --focus-ring-width: 2px;
  --focus-ring-offset: 2px;

  --font-sans:
    "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,
    Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-display:
    "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui,
    -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-chat:
    "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial,
    sans-serif;
}

@media (min-width: 1280px) {

    --workspace-gutter: 1.375rem;
    --workspace-gutter-lg: 2rem;
  }
}

    --workspace-gutter: 1.625rem;
```
