```
  --surface-muted: #f1f4f8;
  --surface-brand-soft: #edf3ff;
  --shell-border: #e2e7ef;
  --shell-border-strong: #9aabc0;

  /* Brand + status */
  --brand-500: #3b82f6;
  --brand-600: #2563eb;
  --brand-700: #1d4ed8;
  --accent-500: #5b5fc7;
  --success-500: #16a34a;
  --warn-500: #f59e0b;
  --danger-500: #dc2626;
  --status-ok-bg: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.14);
  --status-ok-border: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.36);
  --status-ok-text: #046b4d;
  --status-warn-bg: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.14);
  --status-warn-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.34);
  --status-warn-text: #92400e;
  --status-danger-bg: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.14);
  --status-danger-border: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.34);
  --status-danger-text: #b91c1c;
  --status-neutral-bg: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12);
  --status-neutral-border: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.32);
  --status-neutral-text: #334155;
  --dashboard-accent-soft: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14);
  --dashboard-side-panel-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);

  /* Glass */
  --glass-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
  --glass-stroke: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.26);
  --glass-highlight: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
  --blur-sm: 8px;
  --blur-md: 14px;
  --blur-lg: 24px;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
  --radius-xl: 20px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-soft: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-float: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-hero: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14), 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28);
  --shadow-chrome: 0 20px 54px -34px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);

  /* Focus ring (Requirement 5.4) — defined once, reused everywhere */
  --focus-ring-color: var(--brand-700);
  --focus-ring-width: 2px;
  --focus-ring-offset: 2px;

  --font-sans:
    "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,
    Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-display:
    "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui,
    -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-chat:
    "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial,
    sans-serif;
}

@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  :root {
    --workspace-gutter: 1.375rem;
    --workspace-gutter-lg: 2rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1536px) {
  :root {
    --workspace-gutter: 1.625rem;
    --workspace-gutter-lg: 2.25rem;
    --workspace-gutter-2xl: 2.75rem;
  }
}

/* Fluent experience unification -------------------------------------------------
 * Compatibility layer for feature surfaces that predate the shared Fluent
 * foundation. It deliberately removes decorative glass/glow treatments while
 * keeping their layout and behavior contracts intact.
 */
.clara-glass-panel,
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1,
.glass-surface-2,
.glass-surface-3,
.chrome-panel,
.research-panel-modern,
.dashboard-holo-panel,
.dashboard-strip-panel,
.dashboard-side-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

.chrome-shell::before,
.research-workspace::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::after {
  display: none;
}

.clara-glow-cyan,
.glow-cyan {
  box-shadow: none;
}

.clinical-gradient {
  background: var(--brand-600);
}

.research-hero-heading,
.med-gradient-text {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: none;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
}

/* Modern application shell ---------------------------------------------------- */
.app-navigation {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 94%), rgb(249 250 252 / 98%)),
    var(--surface-sidebar);
  box-shadow: 8px 0 28px -28px rgb(15 23 42 / 34%);
}

.app-command-bar {
  background: var(--surface-header);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(145%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(145%);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 26px -28px rgb(15 23 42 / 72%);
}

.app-content-canvas {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
}

.app-content-canvas::before {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 4.5rem 0 0;
  z-index: -1;
  content: "";
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      40rem 22rem at 96% 0%,
      rgb(8 120 189 / 6%),
      transparent 68%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      34rem 20rem at 12% 100%,
      rgb(91 95 199 / 5%),
      transparent 72%
    );
}

.app-brand-mark {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 2.75rem;
  height: 2.75rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--brand-500), var(--brand-700));
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -13px rgb(8 120 189 / 85%);
}

.app-new-chat {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-600) 62%, white);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-600), var(--brand-700));
  box-shadow: 0 9px 22px -16px rgb(8 120 189 / 90%);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition:
    transform 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease,
    filter 150ms ease;
}

.app-new-chat:hover {
  filter: saturate(1.08) brightness(1.03);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -16px rgb(8 120 189 / 95%);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.app-nav-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition:
    color 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease,
    border-color 140ms ease;
}

.app-nav-item:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 76%, transparent);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
}

.app-nav-item-active {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-500) 24%, var(--shell-border));
  color: var(--text-brand);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--surface-brand-soft),
    rgb(255 255 255 / 72%)
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 3px 0 0 var(--brand-600),
    0 3px 12px -11px rgb(8 120 189 / 70%);
  font-weight: 650;
}

.app-sidebar-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition:
    color 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.app-sidebar-action:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.app-ask-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0 0.8rem;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-600), var(--brand-700));
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -14px rgb(8 120 189 / 90%);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.app-topbar-icon,
.app-topbar-language,
.app-mobile-ask {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 2.65rem;
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: transparent;
  transition:
    color 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease,
    border-color 140ms ease;
}

.app-topbar-icon:hover,
.app-topbar-language:hover,
.app-mobile-ask:hover {
  border-color: var(--shell-border);
  color: var(--text-brand);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.app-topbar-language {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.app-mobile-ask {
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--brand-600);
}

.app-profile-chip {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.app-profile-avatar {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-brand);
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--surface-brand-soft),
    var(--surface-muted)
  );
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.page-intro {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem;
}

html.dark .app-navigation,
html[data-theme="dark"] .app-navigation {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(32 32 32 / 96%), rgb(27 26 25 / 98%));
}

html.dark .app-nav-item-active,
html[data-theme="dark"] .app-nav-item-active {
  background: var(--surface-brand-soft);
}

@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .app-content-canvas::before {
    inset: 4rem 0 0;
  }
}

.dashboard-live-pill::before {
  animation: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.fluent-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.fluent-card-subtle {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.fluent-button-primary,
.fluent-button-secondary,
.fluent-icon-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: var(--touch-target-min);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  transition:
    background-color 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease;
}

.fluent-button-primary {
  border: 1px solid var(--brand-700);
  background: var(--brand-600);
  color: #fff;
}

.fluent-button-primary:hover {
  background: var(--brand-700);
}

.fluent-button-secondary,
.fluent-icon-button {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.fluent-button-secondary:hover,
.fluent-icon-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.fluent-icon-button {
  width: var(--touch-target-min);
  padding: 0;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

.medical-markdown {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.medical-markdown::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgb(255 255 255 / 26%),
    rgb(255 255 255 / 0%)
  );
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(148 163 184 / 7%);
}

.medical-markdown table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
  background: rgb(248 250 252 / 72%);
}

html.dark .medical-markdown table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
  background: rgb(15 23 42 / 42%);
}

html.dark .medical-markdown::before,
html[data-theme="dark"] .medical-markdown::before {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(15 23 42 / 14%), rgb(15 23 42 / 0%));
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(148 163 184 / 5%);
}

@media (min-width: 2160px) {
  :root {
    --workspace-gutter: 1.9rem;
    --workspace-gutter-lg: 2.5rem;
    --workspace-gutter-2xl: 3.35rem;
  }
}

html.dark,
html[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --color-bg: #1b1a19;
  --bg-canvas: #1b1a19;
  --bg-elev-1: #242424;
  --bg-elev-2: #292929;
  --bg-elev-3: #303030;
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #d6d6d6;
  --text-muted: #b3b3b3;
  --text-brand: #75b6e7;
  --surface-sidebar: #202020;
  --surface-header: #242424;
  --surface-panel: #292929;
  --surface-muted: #333333;
  --surface-brand-soft: #0f3b5f;
  --shell-border: #484848;
  --shell-border-strong: #8a8886;
  --status-ok-bg: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.24);
  --status-ok-border: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.42);
  --status-ok-text: #6ee7b7;
  --status-warn-bg: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.22);
  --status-warn-border: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
  --status-warn-text: #fcd34d;
  --status-danger-bg: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.22);
  --status-danger-border: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.42);
  --status-danger-text: #fecaca;
  --status-neutral-bg: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
  --status-neutral-border: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.38);
  --status-neutral-text: #cbd5e1;
  --dashboard-accent-soft: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22);
  --dashboard-side-panel-bg: rgba(19, 27, 46, 0.74);
  --glass-fill: rgba(19, 27, 46, 0.6);
  --glass-stroke: rgba(67, 71, 79, 0.42);
  --glass-highlight: rgba(34, 42, 61, 0.65);
  --shadow-soft: 0 18px 36px -30px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.82);
  --shadow-float: 0 26px 62px -42px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.88);
  --shadow-hero: 0 32px 94px -54px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.92);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 155, 255, 0.35);
  --shadow-chrome: 0 22px 56px -34px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.9);
  --focus-ring-color: #7dd3fc;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 28rem at 82% -10%,
      rgb(37 137 202 / 8%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, var(--bg-canvas) 32rem);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-feature-settings:
    "rlig" 1,
    "calt" 1;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

::selection {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgb(37 99 235 / 80%);
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
}

.material-symbols-outlined {
  font-variation-settings:
    "FILL" 0,
    "wght" 400,
    "GRAD" 0,
    "opsz" 24;
}

.clara-glass-panel {
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.clara-glow-cyan {
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
}

.clinical-gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #2563eb 100%);
}

.glow-cyan {
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
}

.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.hide-scrollbar {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.clara-chat-workspace {
  font-family: var(--font-chat);
  --bg-canvas: #f0f6ff;
  --surface-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  --surface-muted: #eff6ff;
  --shell-border: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16);
  --shell-border-strong: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5);
  --text-primary: #1e2a44;
  --text-secondary: #3b4a6b;
  --text-muted: #5b6a80;
  background: radial-gradient(
    120% 130% at 100% -10%,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) 0%,
    #f0f6ff 45%,
    #e8f0fe 100%
  );
}

.clara-chat-workspace h1,
.clara-chat-workspace h2,
.clara-chat-workspace h3,
.clara-chat-workspace h4,
.clara-chat-workspace h5,
.clara-chat-workspace h6,
.clara-chat-workspace button,
.clara-chat-workspace input,
.clara-chat-workspace textarea,
.clara-chat-workspace select {
  font-family: var(--font-chat);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-workspace {
  --bg-canvas: #091326;
  --surface-panel: rgba(13, 25, 48, 0.96);
  --surface-muted: rgba(22, 38, 70, 0.92);
  --shell-border: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24);
  --shell-border-strong: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.48);
  --text-primary: #e6edff;
  --text-secondary: #c4d1ea;
  --text-muted: #91a0ba;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      68rem 34rem at 100% -12%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      46rem 26rem at 0% 108%,
      rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.08),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #081225 0%, #091326 48%, #0d1629 100%);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace .clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
html[data-theme="dark"]
  .clara-chat-workspace
  .clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.38);
}

/*
 * CHAT_V2 (clara-chat-redesign, task 7.1) — WCAG AA contrast hardening.
 *
 * The v2 shell reuses the root design tokens. In dark mode the root
 * `--text-muted` (#8d919a) lands at ~4.0:1 against the v2 `--surface-muted`
 * panels — below the AA 4.5:1 threshold for the small (10–11px) uppercase
 * labels that use it. Scope a slightly lighter muted to the v2 surface only so
 * the audit passes without altering the legacy chat or the rest of the app.
 * All other v2 token pairs (primary/secondary/brand/status text on their
 * backgrounds, both themes) already clear AA.
 */
html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  --text-muted: #9aa7be;
}

.clara-chat-v2 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 24rem at 82% -8%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 7%),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    var(--bg-canvas);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
}

/* Compat classes */
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1 {
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke);
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    var(--glass-highlight),
    var(--glass-fill)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm)) saturate(130%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.glass-surface-2 {
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke);
  background: linear-gradient(
    165deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.44),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)) saturate(140%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
}

.glass-surface-3 {
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
  background: linear-gradient(
    170deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.54)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg)) saturate(150%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hero);
}

.chrome-shell {
  position: relative;
}

.chrome-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 25rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(14 165 233 / 14%),
      transparent 64%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      40rem 18rem at 0% 16%,
      rgb(13 148 136 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 40%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    );
  background-size:
    auto,
    auto,
    20px 20px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.chrome-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74), var(--surface-panel)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
      transparent 58%
    );
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-chrome);
}

html.dark .chrome-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-panel {
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(10, 18, 35, 0.88), rgba(8, 14, 28, 0.9)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 110% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
      transparent 58%
    );
}

.chrome-nav-link {
  min-height: var(--touch-target-min);
  transition:
    border-color 180ms ease,
    background-color 180ms ease,
    box-shadow 180ms ease,
    transform 180ms ease,
    color 180ms ease;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .chrome-nav-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
}

.research-workspace {
  position: relative;
}

.research-workspace::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 20rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 13%),
      transparent 66%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      36rem 16rem at 6% 96%,
      rgb(96 165 250 / 11%),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(15 23 42 / 5%), transparent 45%);
}

.research-workspace > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.research-panel-modern {
  border: 1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 32%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 82%), rgb(255 255 255 / 66%)),
    radial-gradient(120% 95% at 96% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 12%), transparent 58%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(135%);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 55px -36px rgb(2 132 199 / 44%);
}

html.dark .research-panel-modern,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-panel-modern {
  border-color: rgb(34 211 238 / 22%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(166deg, rgb(9 16 31 / 82%), rgb(8 14 28 / 78%)),
    radial-gradient(125% 95% at 96% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 15%), transparent 58%);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 56px -34px rgb(2 6 23 / 86%);
}

.research-chip {
  border: 1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 34%);
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 72%);
  color: rgb(51 65 85);
}

html.dark .research-chip,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-chip {
  border-color: rgb(71 85 105 / 72%);
  background: rgb(15 23 42 / 72%);
  color: rgb(203 213 225);
}

.research-chip-cyan {
  border-color: rgb(56 189 248 / 45%);
  background: rgb(14 116 144 / 16%);
  color: rgb(12 74 110);
}

html.dark .research-chip-cyan,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-chip-cyan {
  border-color: rgb(6 182 212 / 54%);
  background: rgb(8 47 73 / 34%);
  color: rgb(103 232 249);
}

.research-hero-heading {
  color: transparent;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    118deg,
    #9eefff 0%,
    #28d9f3 42%,
    #93c5fd 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
}

.research-live-engine {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgb(34 211 238 / 24%);
  border-radius: 0.95rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(65% 100% at 50% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 20%), transparent 80%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(8 47 73 / 35%), rgb(15 23 42 / 62%));
}

.research-live-engine::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    rgb(148 163 184 / 10%) 1px,
    transparent 1px
  );
  background-size: 18px 100%;
}

.research-live-bars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.research-live-bar {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  border-radius: 0.3rem 0.3rem 0 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgb(34 211 238 / 92%),
    rgb(14 116 144 / 45%)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(34 211 238 / 24%);
}

.research-pulse-dot {
  width: 0.48rem;
  height: 0.48rem;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #28d9f3;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(34 211 238 / 54%);
  animation: research-pulse-dot 1.8s ease-out infinite;
}

@keyframes research-pulse-dot {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(34 211 238 / 55%);
  }
  65% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 0%);
  }
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(34 211 238 / 0%);
  }
}

.med-gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--brand-500), var(--accent-500) 72%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/*
 * Accessibility: visible keyboard focus indicator (Requirement 5.4).
 *
 * A single token-driven focus ring is applied to every interactive control,
 * including custom-role widgets. We draw a real `outline` (not just a
 * box-shadow) so the indicator survives Windows High Contrast / forced-colors
 * mode, and layer the soft brand glow on top for the default theme. Focus is
 * only shown for keyboard interaction via `:focus-visible`, so pointer users
 * are not distracted by rings.
 */
:is(
  a[href],
  button,
  input,
  textarea,
  select,
  summary,
  [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
  [contenteditable="true"],
  [role="button"],
  [role="link"],
  [role="tab"],
  [role="menuitem"],
  [role="menuitemcheckbox"],
  [role="menuitemradio"],
  [role="option"],
  [role="switch"],
  [role="checkbox"],
  [role="radio"]
):focus-visible,
.focus-ring:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
}

/* In forced-colors mode the soft glow is dropped; keep the system-drawn ring. */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :is(
    a[href],
    button,
    input,
    textarea,
    select,
    summary,
    [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
    [contenteditable="true"],
    [role="button"],
    [role="link"],
    [role="tab"],
    [role="menuitem"],
    [role="option"],
    [role="switch"],
    [role="checkbox"],
    [role="radio"]
  ):focus-visible,
  .focus-ring:focus-visible {
    outline-color: Highlight;
  }
}

/*
 * Skip link: the first focusable element in the app shell so keyboard users can
 * jump straight to the main content, keeping a logical tab order (Requirement 5.4).
 * It is visually hidden until focused.
 */
.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0.75rem;
  left: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 100;
  transform: translateY(-180%);
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

.skip-link:focus,
.skip-link:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .skip-link {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@layer components {
  .input {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
    transition:
      border-color 0.15s ease,
      box-shadow 0.15s ease,
      background-color 0.15s ease;
  }
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

.input:hover:not(:disabled):not(:focus) {
  border-color: var(--brand-500);
}

.input:focus,
.input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--brand-600);
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);
}

.input:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background-color: var(--surface-muted);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

html.dark .input,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.7);
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html.dark .input::placeholder,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input::placeholder {
  color: #94a3b8;
}

html.dark .input:focus,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus,
html.dark .input:focus-visible,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus-visible {
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

html.dark body,
html[data-theme="dark"] body {
  background-image: none;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-white,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-white {
  background-color: rgba(12, 20, 36, 0.9) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50 {
  background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.58) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .border-slate-200,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .border-slate-200 {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.62) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-900,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-900 {
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-800,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-800 {
  color: #dbe7f6 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-700,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-700 {
  color: #cdd8ea !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-600,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-600 {
  color: #b2bfd4 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-500,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-500 {
  color: #8ea0bc !important;
}

/* CLARA landing inspired by KP3 */
.clara-shell {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  --clara-motion-fast: 160ms;
  --clara-motion-base: 220ms;
  --clara-motion-slow: 360ms;
  --clara-motion-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      74rem 42rem at 50% -24%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18) 36%,
      transparent 76%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 48%,
      rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.08) 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #010611 0%, #010916 26%, #031231 58%, #020a1d 100%);
  background-size:
    auto,
    16px 16px,
    auto;
}

.clara-shell::before,
.clara-shell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.clara-shell::before {
  inset: -32% 54% auto -16%;
  height: 52rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  filter: blur(6px);
}

.clara-shell::after {
  inset: auto -22% -38% 55%;
  height: 46rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
}

.clara-ambient-layers {
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      30rem 16rem at 15% 28%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18),
      transparent 68%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      34rem 18rem at 84% 18%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      20rem 12rem at 70% 66%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
      transparent 68%
    );
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  animation: clara-ambient-shift 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes clara-ambient-shift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(0, -1.8%, 0) scale(1.03);
  }
}

.clara-grid-overlay {
  z-index: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(66% 56% at 50% 26%, #000 36%, transparent 100%);
  animation: clara-grid-drift 22s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes clara-grid-drift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(16px, 16px, 0);
  }
}

.clara-nav-frame {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.42) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    150deg,
    rgba(6, 18, 45, 0.9),
    rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.94)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 24px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 32px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
}

.clara-nav-link {
  transition:
    color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    background-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    border-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-nav-link:hover {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.5);
  color: #d9f6ff;
  background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.28);
}

.clara-wave-top::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 6%;
  right: 6%;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: clamp(20px, 2vw, 34px);
  border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    70% 140% at 50% 100%,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28),
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-panel {
  isolation: isolate;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      90% 74% at 50% -4%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.34),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 36%,
      rgba(8, 20, 49, 0.92) 72%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.96) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 22, 1) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 48px 110px -62px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.82);
}

.clara-hero-panel::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 8% 3% 8%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.6),
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-constellation {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 9% 7% auto 7%;
  height: 14rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.clara-const-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.6rem;
  height: 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 35%,
    #f0fdff 12%,
    #60a5fa 66%,
    #2563eb 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-const-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 26%;
}
.clara-const-node-b {
  left: 28%;
  top: 12%;
}
.clara-const-node-c {
  right: 20%;
  top: 18%;
}
.clara-const-node-d {
  right: 7%;
  top: 34%;
}

.clara-const-link {
  position: absolute;
  height: 1px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.8),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0)
  );
}

.clara-const-link-a {
  left: 8.4%;
  top: 28.4%;
  width: 24%;
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
}

.clara-const-link-b {
  left: 30.2%;
  top: 14%;
  width: 44%;
  transform: rotate(5deg);
}

.clara-dome-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      116% 92% at 50% -6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.48),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) 34%,
      rgba(8, 16, 38, 0.95) 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.99), rgba(4, 10, 26, 1));
}

.clara-dark-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      92% 80% at 50% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.19),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 18, 42, 0.93), rgba(5, 12, 28, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.08),
    0 30px 58px -40px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92);
}

.clara-model-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      76% 68% at 50% 6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.22),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 40%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 23, 53, 0.97), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
    0 30px 60px -44px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.7);
  min-height: 360px;
}

.clara-glass-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.34) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 0% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.16),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(8, 24, 55, 0.86), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.88)) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 26px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-kpi-card {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-card-equal {
  min-height: 430px;
}

.clara-stat-card {
  min-height: 168px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-dark-card,
.clara-model-card {
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .clara-dark-card:hover,
  .clara-model-card:hover,
  .clara-kpi-card:hover,
  .clara-stat-card:hover,
  .clara-glass-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
      0 34px 62px -38px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.66),
      0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
  }
}

.clara-neon-button {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.56);
  background: linear-gradient(98deg, #183dbd 0%, #1f58d6 46%, #09649f 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.26),
    0 14px 36px -18px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 28px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    filter var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.4);
}

.clara-neon-button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -110% auto -110% -42%;
  width: 34%;
  transform: rotate(15deg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)
  );
  opacity: 0.45;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-slow) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    opacity var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    0 20px 44px -20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 34px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(350%) rotate(15deg);
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.clara-neon-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.clara-display-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 11.2vw, 9rem);
  line-height: 0.97;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 26px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.3),
    0 3px 16px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.62);
}

.clara-sub-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6.4vw, 5.85rem);
  line-height: 1.03;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.58);
}

/* Futuristic dashboard utilities */
.futura-panel {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 82%, #60a5fa 18%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(56 189 248 / 10%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(120% 84% at 0% 100%, rgb(16 185 129 / 7%), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 94%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 88%, transparent)
    );
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(118%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 22%),
    0 14px 30px -28px rgb(2 132 199 / 36%);
}

.futura-panel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 18px 18px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(80% 65% at 50% 15%, #000 30%, transparent 100%);
  opacity: 0.46;
}

.futura-card {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 84%, #60a5fa 16%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 8%), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(
      170deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 90%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -20px rgb(15 23 42 / 22%);
}

.futura-kpi {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 86%, #60a5fa 14%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 92%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -16px rgb(15 23 42 / 18%);
}

.futura-chip {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 68%, #60a5fa 32%);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 84%, transparent);
}

html.dark .futura-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .futura-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 12%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 0% 100%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(6 12 24 / 90%), rgb(4 10 20 / 92%));
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .futura-card:hover,
  .futura-kpi:hover,
  .futura-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 20%),
      0 14px 26px -20px rgb(14 165 233 / 28%),
      0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 14%);
  }
}

.clara-copy-rhythm {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.45vw + 0.93rem, 1.16rem);
  line-height: clamp(1.78rem, 0.75vw + 1.6rem, 2.12rem);
}

.clara-cta-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.44);
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    rgba(8, 21, 48, 0.8),
    rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.86)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 26px 64px -44px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9),
    0 0 26px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-cta-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.clara-cta-stack > .clara-neon-button {
  width: min(100%, 23.5rem);
}

.clara-final-cta-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      112% 82% at 50% -12%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16) 45%,
      rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.96) 74%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.98), rgba(4, 14, 34, 1));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
    0 40px 90px -58px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.94);
}

.clara-medical-band {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 28rem at 12% 6%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.24),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      52rem 24rem at 88% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.26),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #051127 0%, #041028 54%, #05152f 100%);
}

.clara-medical-band-soft {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 30rem at 78% -8%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      42rem 20rem at 16% 100%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #041028 0%, #041128 100%);
}

.clara-medical-panel,
.clara-medical-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(6, 20, 48, 0.88), rgba(3, 12, 30, 0.92)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 55%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 30px 62px -42px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.58);
}

.clara-med-heading {
  color: #f8fcff;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.22),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-copy {
  color: #cbd5e1;
  max-width: 62ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.clara-med-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.46),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16)
  );
  color: #d0f2ff;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.clara-rating-pill {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.35);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.34),
    rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.46)
  );
  padding: 0.36rem 0.72rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: rgba(219, 234, 254, 0.95);
}

.clara-star-icon {
  color: #93c5fd;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.35));
}

.clara-play-button {
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-play-button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -0.65rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35);
  animation: clara-pulse-ring 2.2s ease-out infinite;
  z-index: -1;
}

@keyframes clara-pulse-ring {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.8;
    transform: scale(0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.34);
  }
  70% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.06);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 13px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.06);
  }
}

.clara-medical-bullet {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.5rem;
}

.clara-medical-bullet::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.55rem;
  width: 0.72rem;
  height: 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 0.3rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 58%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      transparent 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 58%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.26), rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.18);
}

.clara-medical-visual {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(13rem, 28vw, 20rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
}

.clara-med-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 21%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 34% 28%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.55) 35%,
    rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.86) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset -16px -14px 28px rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.45),
    0 20px 40px -28px rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.85),
    0 0 42px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
}

.clara-med-ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-ring-a {
  inset: 9%;
  transform: rotate(10deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-a 16s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-ring-b {
  inset: 3%;
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.34);
  transform: rotate(-16deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-b 20s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-cross {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18%;
  right: 11%;
  width: 2.55rem;
  height: 2.55rem;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    rgba(14, 116, 255, 0.96),
    rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.96)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.86);
}

.clara-med-cross::before,
.clara-med-cross::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
}

.clara-med-cross::before {
  top: 50%;
  left: 24%;
  right: 24%;
  height: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-cross::after {
  left: 50%;
  top: 24%;
  bottom: 24%;
  width: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.72rem;
  height: 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.4);
}

.clara-med-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 39%;
}

.clara-med-node-b {
  right: 6%;
  top: 45%;
}

.clara-med-node-c {
  left: 24%;
  bottom: 6%;
}

.clara-med-node-d {
  right: 20%;
  bottom: 11%;
}

.clara-data-orbit {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(5.6rem, 14vw, 7.4rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  animation: clara-orbit-breathe 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.clara-data-orbit-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 24%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 30%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.94) 70%,
    rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.98)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 42%;
  height: 2px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.88)
  );
}

.clara-data-orbit-link::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -0.35rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0.66rem;
  height: 0.66rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.42);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-a {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(20deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-b {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(138deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-c {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(264deg);
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-a {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(10deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(370deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-b {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(-16deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(-376deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-breathe {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
}

html.dark .clara-medical-panel,
html.dark .clara-medical-card,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(5, 16, 38, 0.9), rgba(3, 10, 24, 0.94)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22),
      transparent 55%
    );
}

.clara-section,
.clara-section-strong {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-section::before,
.clara-section-strong::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(92%, 1320px);
  height: 1px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 20%,
    rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.62) 50%,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 80%,
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section::after,
.clara-section-strong::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(82%, 1040px);
  height: 24px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -60%);
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 4.7vw, 7.1rem);
}

.clara-section-strong {
  padding-block: clamp(3.6rem, 5.7vw, 8.2rem);
}

.clara-neon-text {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    #ffffff 0%,
    #e6f8ff 24%,
    #b3edff 48%,
    #93c5fd 76%,
    #60a5fa 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.66),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.5);
}

.dashboard-atmosphere {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.dashboard-atmosphere::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6rem -2rem auto -2rem;
  height: 17rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      58rem 17rem at 90% 8%,
      rgb(14 165 233 / 18%),
      transparent 65%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      44rem 16rem at 8% 32%,
      rgb(13 148 136 / 14%),
      transparent 72%
    );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.dashboard-atmosphere::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 24% 12%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.3px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 76% 72%,
      rgb(20 184 166 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.3px
    );
  background-size:
    24px 24px,
    22px 22px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.54;
}

.dashboard-fade-up {
  animation: dashboard-fade-up 230ms ease-out both;
}

.dashboard-holo-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8),
      rgba(248, 252, 255, 0.72)
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
      transparent 58%
    );
  box-shadow:
    0 24px 66px -44px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
}

html.dark .dashboard-holo-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-holo-panel {
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(8, 16, 30, 0.9), rgba(5, 12, 24, 0.88)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18),
      transparent 58%
    );
}

.dashboard-strip-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88),
      rgba(247, 252, 255, 0.78)
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    );
  box-shadow: 0 18px 52px -40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.48);
}

html.dark .dashboard-strip-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-strip-panel {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 16, 30, 0.88), rgba(7, 14, 28, 0.82)),
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.2) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    );
}

.dashboard-side-panel {
  background: var(--dashboard-side-panel-bg);
  box-shadow:
    0 14px 42px -34px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.52),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34);
}

.dashboard-live-pill {
  color: var(--text-brand);
  border-color: var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: linear-gradient(
    140deg,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
    rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.12)
  );
}

.dashboard-live-pill::before {
  content: "";
  width: 0.45rem;
  height: 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-right: 0.4rem;
  background: currentColor;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.42);
  animation: dashboard-live-pulse 1.8s ease-out infinite;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="1"] {
  animation-delay: 45ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="2"] {
  animation-delay: 80ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="3"] {
  animation-delay: 115ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="4"] {
  animation-delay: 150ms;
}

@keyframes dashboard-fade-up {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes dashboard-live-pulse {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.42);
  }
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .clara-ambient-layers,
  .clara-grid-overlay,
  .clara-neon-button::before,
  .clara-play-button::after,
  .clara-med-ring-a,
  .clara-med-ring-b,
  .clara-data-orbit,
  .dashboard-fade-up,
  .dashboard-live-pill::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .clara-rating-pill {
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    padding: 0.32rem 0.65rem;
  }

  .clara-grid-overlay {
    background-size: 26px 26px;
  }

  .clara-hero-constellation {
    display: none;
  }

  .clara-hero-panel {
    border-radius: 1.35rem;
  }

  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 14.5vw, 4.2rem);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 11vw, 3.1rem);
    line-height: 1.04;
  }

  .clara-copy-rhythm {
    font-size: 0.99rem;
    line-height: 1.78rem;
  }

  .clara-cta-panel .clara-neon-button,
  .clara-cta-stack > .clara-neon-button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .clara-section::after,
  .clara-section-strong::after {
    width: min(94%, 420px);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(2.7rem, 9.6vw, 3.5rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 11.2vw, 4rem);
  }

  .clara-kpi-card,
  .clara-model-card,
  .clara-card-equal,
  .clara-stat-card {
    min-height: unset;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(4.2rem, 10.5vw, 6.9rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 6.6vw, 4.6rem);
  }

  .clara-copy-rhythm {
    font-size: clamp(1.03rem, 0.85vw + 0.74rem, 1.14rem);
    line-height: clamp(1.86rem, 1.35vw + 1.45rem, 2.08rem);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 6.8vw, 5rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(4rem, 7.6vw, 5.8rem);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-width: 1535px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(6rem, 7vw, 7.8rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(3.7rem, 5.3vw, 5.4rem);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(4.1rem, 5vw, 6.2rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(4.7rem, 5.8vw, 7rem);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1536px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(7.2rem, 7.5vw, 9.8rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(4.9rem, 4.9vw, 6.3rem);
  }

  .clara-model-card {
    min-height: 390px;
  }

  .clara-card-equal {
    min-height: 465px;
  }

  .clara-stat-card {
    min-height: 198px;
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(5.2rem, 4.6vw, 7.4rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(6rem, 5vw, 8.5rem);
  }
}

/* Keep legacy feature surfaces visually aligned after their older declarations. */
.clara-glass-panel,
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1,
.glass-surface-2,
.glass-surface-3,
.chrome-panel,
.research-panel-modern,
.dashboard-holo-panel,
.dashboard-strip-panel,
.dashboard-side-panel,
html.dark .chrome-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-panel,
html.dark .research-panel-modern,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-panel-modern,
html.dark .dashboard-holo-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-holo-panel,
html.dark .dashboard-strip-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-strip-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

.chrome-shell::before,
.research-workspace::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::after {
  display: none;
}

.research-hero-heading,
.med-gradient-text {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: none;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
```
```json
}
```

```

﻿"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { isAxiosError } from "axios";
import { ReactNode, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import SidebarNav from "@/components/sidebar-nav";
import MobileBottomNav from "@/components/navigation/mobile-bottom-nav";
import AppTopbar from "@/components/navigation/app-topbar";
import TransparencyNoticeGate from "@/components/compliance/transparency-notice-gate";
import {
  clearTokens,
  getRole,
  setRole as setStoredRole,
} from "@/lib/auth-store";
import api from "@/lib/http-client";
import { beginLogout } from "@/lib/logout";
import {
  getGroupMeta,
  getGroupedNavItems,
  getRoleHomePath,
  isActiveRoute,
  isAuthenticatedUtilityRoute,
  isPublicRoute,
  isRouteAllowedForRole,
  type UserRole,
} from "@/lib/navigation.config";
import {
  applyThemePreference,
  getStoredThemePreference,
  saveThemePreference,
  type ThemePreference,
} from "@/lib/theme";
import {
  hydrateUILanguagePreference,
  saveUILanguage,
  type UILanguage,
} from "@/lib/ui-language";
import {
  getActiveProfileId,
  setActiveProfileId,
  type ProfileContext,
} from "@/lib/profile-context";
import { activateOwnedProfile, getProfileContext } from "@/lib/profile-context-api";
import { listFamilyNotifications } from "@/lib/visit-family";
import { getPhrOnboarding } from "@/lib/phr-onboarding";

type Props = {
  children: ReactNode;
};

const THEME_OPTIONS: Array<{
  value: ThemePreference;
  label: string;
  iconClass: string;
}> = [
  { value: "light", label: "Sang", iconClass: "fa-sun-o" },
  { value: "dark", label: "Toi", iconClass: "fa-moon-o" },
  { value: "system", label: "System", iconClass: "fa-desktop" },
];

const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: UILanguage; label: string }> = [
  { value: "vi", label: "VI" },
  { value: "en", label: "EN" },
];

const WIDE_WORKSPACE_PREFIXES = [
  "/admin",
  "/research",
  "/selfmed",
  "/careguard",
  "/dashboard",
  "/council",
  "/scribe",
  "/chat",
];

const IMMERSIVE_LAYOUT_PREFIXES = ["/chat", "/research", "/council", "/scribe"];
const SIDEBAR_COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY = "clara_sidebar_collapsed";

export default function AppShell({ children }: Props) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [role, setRole] = useState<UserRole>("normal");
  const [themePreference, setThemePreference] =
    useState<ThemePreference>("light");
  const [uiLanguage, setUiLanguage] = useState<UILanguage>("vi");
  const [isMobileNavOpen, setIsMobileNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoggingOut, setIsLoggingOut] = useState(false);
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [isRoleHydrated, setIsRoleHydrated] = useState(false);
  const [isSessionChecked, setIsSessionChecked] = useState(false);
  const [profileContext, setProfileContext] = useState<ProfileContext | null>(null);
  const [isProfileChanging, setIsProfileChanging] = useState(false);
  const [familyNotificationCount, setFamilyNotificationCount] = useState(0);

  const hideSidebar = isPublicRoute(pathname);
  const isWideWorkspace = WIDE_WORKSPACE_PREFIXES.some(
    (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`),
  );
  const isImmersiveLayout = IMMERSIVE_LAYOUT_PREFIXES.some(
    (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`),
  );
  const isChatLayout = pathname === "/chat" || pathname.startsWith("/chat/");

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const hydrateSession = async () => {
      if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {
        setRole(getRole());
        setIsRoleHydrated(true);
        setIsSessionChecked(true);
        return;
      }
      // Local storage is only a presentation hint. The API session is
      // authoritative so a stale cookie or a new browser cannot silently
      // downgrade a doctor/researcher/admin to the normal route guard.
      try {
        const response = await api.get<{ role?: UserRole }>("/auth/me", {
          timeout: 15000,
        });
        const serverRole = response.data?.role;
        if (
          active &&
          (serverRole === "normal" ||
            serverRole === "researcher" ||
            serverRole === "doctor" ||
            serverRole === "admin")
        ) {
          setStoredRole(serverRole);
          setRole(serverRole);
        } else if (active) {
          setRole(getRole());
        }
      } catch (error) {
        const status = isAxiosError(error)
          ? Number(error.response?.status ?? 0)
          : 0;
        if (active && status === 401) {
          clearTokens();
          router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}`);
          return;
        }
        if (active) setRole(getRole());
      } finally {
        if (active) {
          setIsRoleHydrated(true);
          setIsSessionChecked(true);
        }
      }
    };
    void hydrateSession();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [pathname, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hideSidebar || !isSessionChecked) {
      if (hideSidebar) {
        setProfileContext(null);
        setFamilyNotificationCount(0);
      }
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    const loadProfileContext = async () => {
      try {
        const [context, notifications] = await Promise.all([
          getProfileContext(),
          listFamilyNotifications().catch(() => []),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;
        // A revoked/expired shared profile is resolved by the server back to a
        // safe context. Persist exactly that answer and discard old UI caches.
        if (context.reset_required || context.active_profile_id !== getActiveProfileId()) {
          setActiveProfileId(context.active_profile_id);
        }
        setProfileContext(context);
        setFamilyNotificationCount(notifications.length);
      } catch {
        // Profile context is additive. The existing authenticated shell stays
        // usable if an older API deployment does not expose this endpoint.
        if (active) {
          setProfileContext(null);
          setFamilyNotificationCount(0);
        }
      }
    };
    void loadProfileContext();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [hideSidebar, isSessionChecked]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMobileNavOpen(false);
  }, [pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobileNavOpen) return;
    const prev = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = prev;
    };
  }, [isMobileNavOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobileNavOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setIsMobileNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [isMobileNavOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1024px)");
    const onChange = (event: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
      if (event.matches) {
        setIsMobileNavOpen(false);
      }
    };

    if (typeof media.addEventListener === "function") {
      media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
      return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    }

    media.addListener(onChange);
    return () => media.removeListener(onChange);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = getStoredThemePreference();
    setThemePreference(stored);
    applyThemePreference(stored);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = hydrateUILanguagePreference();
    setUiLanguage(stored);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = uiLanguage;
  }, [uiLanguage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SIDEBAR_COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY);
      setIsSidebarCollapsed(raw === "1");
    } catch {
      setIsSidebarCollapsed(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (themePreference !== "system") return;
    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const onChange = () => applyThemePreference("system");

    if (typeof media.addEventListener === "function") {
      media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
      return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    }

    media.addListener(onChange);
    return () => media.removeListener(onChange);
  }, [themePreference]);

  const mobileNavGroups = useMemo(() => getGroupedNavItems(role), [role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) return;
    if (!isRoleHydrated || !isSessionChecked) return;
    const allowed =
      isAuthenticatedUtilityRoute(pathname) ||
      isRouteAllowedForRole(pathname, role);
    if (allowed) return;
    router.replace(getRoleHomePath(role));
  }, [isRoleHydrated, isSessionChecked, pathname, role, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) return;
    if (!isRoleHydrated || !isSessionChecked || role !== "normal") return;
    let active = true;
    const enforceFirstRunSetup = async () => {
      try {
        const onboarding = await getPhrOnboarding();
        if (!active) return;
        if (onboarding.needs_onboarding && pathname !== "/welcome") {
          router.replace("/welcome");
          return;
        }
        if (!onboarding.needs_onboarding && pathname === "/welcome") {
          router.replace(getRoleHomePath(role));
        }
      } catch {
        // Fail open when the additive onboarding endpoint is temporarily
        // unavailable; established product surfaces remain usable.
      }
    };
    void enforceFirstRunSetup();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isRoleHydrated, isSessionChecked, pathname, role, router]);

  const handleThemeChange = (nextTheme: ThemePreference) => {
    setThemePreference(nextTheme);
    saveThemePreference(nextTheme);
    applyThemePreference(nextTheme);
  };

  const handleLanguageChange = (nextLanguage: UILanguage) => {
    setUiLanguage(nextLanguage);
    saveUILanguage(nextLanguage);
  };

  const toggleSidebarCollapse = () => {
    setIsSidebarCollapsed((current) => {
      const next = !current;
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          SIDEBAR_COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY,
          next ? "1" : "0",
        );
      } catch {
        // noop
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    if (isLoggingOut) return;
    setIsLoggingOut(true);
    setIsMobileNavOpen(false);
    beginLogout();
  };

  const handleProfileChange = async (profileId: string) => {
    if (!profileId || profileId === profileContext?.active_profile_id || isProfileChanging) return;
    const target = profileContext?.profiles.find((profile) => profile.id === profileId);
    // Shared profiles are display contexts only in this release. A selection
    // cannot turn a narrow Family grant into a whole-record workspace.
    if (!target || target.kind !== "self") return;
    setIsProfileChanging(true);
    try {
      const activation = await activateOwnedProfile(profileId);
      setActiveProfileId(activation.active_profile_id);
      const context = await getProfileContext();
      setProfileContext(context);
      setIsMobileNavOpen(false);
      // Route replacement remounts feature pages, so component-local arrays
      // cannot paint the previous profile while the new context is active.
      router.replace("/today");
      router.refresh();
    } finally {
      setIsProfileChanging(false);
    }
  };

  const activeProfile = useMemo(
    () =>
      profileContext?.profiles.find(
        (profile) => profile.id === profileContext.active_profile_id,
      ) ?? null,
    [profileContext],
  );

  if (hideSidebar) {
    return (
      <main
        id="main-content"
        className="min-h-[100dvh] bg-[var(--bg-canvas)] text-[var(--text-primary)]"
      >
        {children}
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-canvas)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">
      <a href="#main-content" className="skip-link">
        Bỏ qua, tới nội dung chính
      </a>
      <TransparencyNoticeGate />
      <div
        className={[
          "relative z-[1] mx-auto flex min-h-screen w-full",
          isWideWorkspace ? "max-w-[2520px]" : "max-w-[1840px]",
        ].join(" ")}
      >
        <SidebarNav
          role={role}
          collapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
          onToggleCollapse={toggleSidebarCollapse}
          themePreference={themePreference}
          onThemeChange={handleThemeChange}
          uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
          onLanguageChange={handleLanguageChange}
          activeProfile={activeProfile}
        />

        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <AppTopbar
            role={role}
            themePreference={themePreference}
            onThemeChange={handleThemeChange}
            uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
            onLanguageChange={handleLanguageChange}
            profiles={profileContext?.profiles}
            activeProfileId={profileContext?.active_profile_id}
            onProfileChange={handleProfileChange}
            isProfileChanging={isProfileChanging}
            familyNotificationCount={familyNotificationCount}
          />

          <header className="app-command-bar sticky top-0 z-40 flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-[color:var(--shell-border)] px-4 lg:hidden">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsMobileNavOpen(true)}

            <Link
              href={getRoleHomePath(role)}
```

```
# CLARA Medical Answer Harness and Research Workspace Specification

Status: implementation baseline, 2026-07-22

## Product promise

CLARA is not a general-purpose chatbot with medical words added. It is a role-aware
medical reasoning workspace. Every useful answer is an inspectable artifact with an
urgency decision, explicit assumptions, evidence lineage, medication safety checks,
uncertainty, and a next action. The facts and evidence do not change by role; the
presentation and controls do.

The product has three simple entry points:

- **Ask CLARA (everyone):** understand symptoms, results, and medicines; identify
  urgency; prepare for a clinician visit.
- **Clinical view (doctors):** problem representation, cannot-miss diagnoses,
  ranked differential, discriminating questions/tests, medication reconciliation,
  and a reviewable assessment/plan.
- **Research workspace (researchers and clinicians):** reproducible PICO/PECO
  question, source plan, screening/extraction, evidence certainty, contradictions,
  and a versioned living review.

## Evidence and safety basis

The design follows WHO’s ethics and governance principles for AI in health and its
large multimodal model guidance: human agency, safety, transparency, accountability,
equity, and protection of privacy. It uses FDA clinical decision-support transparency
as the boundary for clinician-facing recommendations: the evidence basis must be
available for independent professional review. Research reports follow PRISMA 2020
reporting fields; outcome certainty uses GRADE domains (risk of bias, inconsistency,
indirectness, imprecision, and publication bias). Consumer language follows AHRQ
teach-back and CDC plain-language guidance.

Primary references:

- WHO, [Ethics and governance of AI for health](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240029200)
- WHO, [Ethics and governance of large multimodal models](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240084759)
- FDA, [Clinical Decision Support Software guidance](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/clinical-decision-support-software)
- Cochrane, [GRADE certainty of evidence](https://training.cochrane.org/handbook/current/chapter-14)
- PRISMA, [PRISMA 2020 checklist](https://www.prisma-statement.org/prisma-2020-checklist)
- AHRQ, [Teach-back](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/tools/teachback.html)

## Medical Answer Harness

The request pipeline is a gated graph, not one prompt:

1. Normalize language, role, intent, age group, pregnancy, acuity, medicines, and
   whether the request is consumer education, clinical decision support, or research.
2. Extract a structured clinical state. Distinguish user-entered facts from model
   inferences and show missing high-impact facts.
3. Run a deterministic emergency/red-flag gate before retrieval or generation. An
   emergency result leads with urgent action and does not delay escalation for more
   questions.
4. Ask only high-information clarification questions that could change urgency,
   differential, medication safety, or the research protocol.
5. Resolve drugs to normalized ingredients/RxNorm identifiers and run deterministic
   DrugBank interaction, duplication, allergy, dose/unit, and patient-factor checks.
   Combine DrugBank with current labels and safety communications; never infer “no
   interaction” from a failed lookup.
6. Plan retrieval by claim type: official guideline/regulatory label, systematic
   review, primary study, trial registry, or patient education source.
7. Store an evidence snapshot. Each source has a stable identifier, title, publisher,
   publication/effective date, retrieval timestamp, study type, population, excerpt
   hash, and retraction/correction state.
8. Build atomic claims and a claim-to-evidence graph. Unsupported claims are labeled
   uncertain and cannot appear in decision-ready sections.
9. Synthesize a role-specific answer from the same verified facts.
10. Verify citation entailment, contradictions, dates, population applicability,
    dose/units, allergies, contraindications, and unsafe omissions. Repair or abstain
    when a gate fails.

Stable result contract: `medical_answer_v2` contains `audience`, `intent`, `urgency`,
`actions_now`, `actions_today`, `monitoring`, `red_flags`, `problem_representation`,
`differential`, `medication_safety`, `claims`, `evidence`, `contradictions`,
`assumptions`, `missing_information`, `uncertainty`, `follow_up`, and `run_manifest`.

Consumer output leads with “What to do now”, uses plain language, gives red flags,
safe self-care and “do not” actions, and ends with a teach-back question. It never
prescribes, starts, stops, or titrates prescription treatment.

Clinician output adds a one-line problem representation, cannot-miss diagnoses,
evidence-for/evidence-against differentials, discriminating tests, immediate versus
conditional management, medication reconciliation, and a copyable but explicitly
review-required SOAP/handoff artifact.

## Research workspace

Research is a persistent, reproducible workspace rather than a disposable answer.
The user can edit the question and PICO/PECO fields, select source families, attach
files, answer clarification questions, and inspect the live job stages. A run stores:

- protocol/question, inclusion and exclusion criteria;
- exact search strings, sources, timestamps, filters, and dataset versions;
- deduplicated records and screening decisions;
- extraction matrix (design, population, intervention/exposure, comparator, outcomes,
  follow-up, effect, funding, limitations);
- risk-of-bias and outcome-level GRADE judgments with reasons;
- claim passports, supporting excerpts, contradictory evidence, and applicability;
- export/share version and a “watch this question” update cursor.

The UI exposes four progressive surfaces: **Frame** (PICO and missing fields),
**Search** (sources and executable plan), **Synthesize** (claims, effects,
contradictions, certainty), and **Watch** (new trials, corrections, retractions,
guideline changes, and semantic conclusion diffs). A report is called a rapid
evidence summary unless the declared protocol and PRISMA fields are actually complete.

## Non-negotiable invariants

- Emergency cases bypass normal retrieval and are tested in Vietnamese and English.
- Critical DrugBank findings survive every answer renderer verbatim as deterministic
  safety findings.
- Each actionable claim has an evidence snapshot or is explicitly uncertain and
  suppressed from decision-ready sections.
- Personal records enter a model request only after current explicit consent and an
  on-screen context preview.
- Provider API keys are never accepted into or persisted in research job payloads.
- Role changes presentation only; they never change claim truth or citation support.
- Research jobs and events survive API restart, support cancellation, and represent
  actual work rather than elapsed-time placeholders.
- Degraded answers cannot look decision-ready.

## Evaluation and release gates

Maintain role/language/specialty/acuity suites for emergency sensitivity, critical DDI
recall, contraindications/allergies, citation precision and entailment, freshness,
PICO fidelity, screening/extraction agreement, GRADE agreement, readability, and
abstention calibration. Fabricated citations, missed curated emergencies, and
contraindicated high-risk medication instructions are zero-tolerance deployment
blocks. Human-factors and post-release drift monitoring are required before expanding
high-impact clinical recommendations.

## Current implementation slice

This release fixes authoritative session/role hydration, restores reachable Research
routes, provides a real job-backed Research workspace with upload/source/clarification
controls, and exposes role-filtered tools from Chat. Existing API/ML research jobs,
source hub, DrugBank, citation, export, and share contracts are reused; no mock data
is introduced. Durable answer-run/evidence-snapshot persistence, deterministic
claim gates, worker recovery, and true token streaming remain tracked as the next
backend migration slice and must not be represented as complete until their gates
pass.
```
