```
  --status-neutral-bg: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
  --status-neutral-border: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.38);
  --status-neutral-text: #cbd5e1;
  --dashboard-accent-soft: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22);
  --dashboard-side-panel-bg: rgba(19, 27, 46, 0.74);
  --glass-fill: rgba(19, 27, 46, 0.6);
  --glass-stroke: rgba(67, 71, 79, 0.42);
  --glass-highlight: rgba(34, 42, 61, 0.65);
  --shadow-soft: 0 18px 36px -30px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.82);
  --shadow-float: 0 26px 62px -42px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.88);
  --shadow-hero: 0 32px 94px -54px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.92);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 155, 255, 0.35);
  --shadow-chrome: 0 22px 56px -34px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.9);
  --focus-ring-color: #7dd3fc;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 28rem at 82% -10%,
      rgb(37 137 202 / 8%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, var(--bg-canvas) 32rem);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-feature-settings:
    "rlig" 1,
    "calt" 1;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

::selection {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgb(37 99 235 / 80%);
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
}

.material-symbols-outlined {
  font-variation-settings:
    "FILL" 0,
    "wght" 400,
    "GRAD" 0,
    "opsz" 24;
}

.clara-glass-panel {
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.clara-glow-cyan {
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
}

.clinical-gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #2563eb 100%);
}

.glow-cyan {
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
}

.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.hide-scrollbar {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.clara-chat-workspace {
  font-family: var(--font-chat);
  --bg-canvas: #f0f6ff;
  --surface-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  --surface-muted: #eff6ff;
  --shell-border: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16);
  --shell-border-strong: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5);
  --text-primary: #1e2a44;
  --text-secondary: #3b4a6b;
  --text-muted: #5b6a80;
  background: radial-gradient(
    120% 130% at 100% -10%,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) 0%,
    #f0f6ff 45%,
    #e8f0fe 100%
  );
}

.clara-chat-workspace h1,
.clara-chat-workspace h2,
.clara-chat-workspace h3,
.clara-chat-workspace h4,
.clara-chat-workspace h5,
.clara-chat-workspace h6,
.clara-chat-workspace button,
.clara-chat-workspace input,
.clara-chat-workspace textarea,
.clara-chat-workspace select {
  font-family: var(--font-chat);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-workspace {
  --bg-canvas: #091326;
  --surface-panel: rgba(13, 25, 48, 0.96);
  --surface-muted: rgba(22, 38, 70, 0.92);
  --shell-border: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24);
  --shell-border-strong: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.48);
  --text-primary: #e6edff;
  --text-secondary: #c4d1ea;
  --text-muted: #91a0ba;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      68rem 34rem at 100% -12%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      46rem 26rem at 0% 108%,
      rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.08),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #081225 0%, #091326 48%, #0d1629 100%);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-workspace .clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
html[data-theme="dark"]
  .clara-chat-workspace
  .clara-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.38);
}

/*
 * CHAT_V2 (clara-chat-redesign, task 7.1) — WCAG AA contrast hardening.
 *
 * The v2 shell reuses the root design tokens. In dark mode the root
 * `--text-muted` (#8d919a) lands at ~4.0:1 against the v2 `--surface-muted`
 * panels — below the AA 4.5:1 threshold for the small (10–11px) uppercase
 * labels that use it. Scope a slightly lighter muted to the v2 surface only so
 * the audit passes without altering the legacy chat or the rest of the app.
 * All other v2 token pairs (primary/secondary/brand/status text on their
 * backgrounds, both themes) already clear AA.
 */
html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  --text-muted: #9aa7be;
}

.clara-chat-v2 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 24rem at 82% -8%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 7%),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    var(--bg-canvas);
}

html.dark .clara-chat-v2,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-chat-v2 {
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
}

/* Compat classes */
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1 {
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke);
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    var(--glass-highlight),
    var(--glass-fill)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm)) saturate(130%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.glass-surface-2 {
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke);
  background: linear-gradient(
    165deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.44),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)) saturate(140%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
}

.glass-surface-3 {
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
  background: linear-gradient(
    170deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.54)
  );
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg)) saturate(150%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hero);
}

.chrome-shell {
  position: relative;
}

.chrome-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 25rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(14 165 233 / 14%),
      transparent 64%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      40rem 18rem at 0% 16%,
      rgb(13 148 136 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 40%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    );
  background-size:
    auto,
    auto,
    20px 20px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.chrome-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74), var(--surface-panel)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
      transparent 58%
    );
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-chrome);
}

html.dark .chrome-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-panel {

    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(10, 18, 35, 0.88), rgba(8, 14, 28, 0.9)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 110% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
      transparent 58%
    );
}

.chrome-nav-link {
  min-height: var(--touch-target-min);
  transition:
    border-color 180ms ease,
    background-color 180ms ease,
    box-shadow 180ms ease,
    transform 180ms ease,

}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .chrome-nav-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
}

.research-workspace {
  position: relative;
}

.research-workspace::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      48rem 20rem at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 13%),
      transparent 66%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      36rem 16rem at 6% 96%,
      rgb(96 165 250 / 11%),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(15 23 42 / 5%), transparent 45%);
}

.research-workspace > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.research-panel-modern {
  border: 1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 32%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 82%), rgb(255 255 255 / 66%)),
    radial-gradient(120% 95% at 96% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 12%), transparent 58%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(135%);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 55px -36px rgb(2 132 199 / 44%);
}

html.dark .research-panel-modern,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-panel-modern {
  border-color: rgb(34 211 238 / 22%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(166deg, rgb(9 16 31 / 82%), rgb(8 14 28 / 78%)),
    radial-gradient(125% 95% at 96% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 15%), transparent 58%);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 56px -34px rgb(2 6 23 / 86%);
}

.research-chip {
  border: 1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 34%);
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 72%);
  color: rgb(51 65 85);
}

html.dark .research-chip,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-chip {
  border-color: rgb(71 85 105 / 72%);
  background: rgb(15 23 42 / 72%);
  color: rgb(203 213 225);
}

.research-chip-cyan {
  border-color: rgb(56 189 248 / 45%);
  background: rgb(14 116 144 / 16%);
  color: rgb(12 74 110);
}

html.dark .research-chip-cyan,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-chip-cyan {
  border-color: rgb(6 182 212 / 54%);

  color: rgb(103 232 249);
}

.research-hero-heading {
  color: transparent;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    118deg,
    #9eefff 0%,
    #28d9f3 42%,
    #93c5fd 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
}

.research-live-engine {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgb(34 211 238 / 24%);
  border-radius: 0.95rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(65% 100% at 50% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 20%), transparent 80%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(8 47 73 / 35%), rgb(15 23 42 / 62%));
}

.research-live-engine::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    rgb(148 163 184 / 10%) 1px,
    transparent 1px
  );
  background-size: 18px 100%;
}

.research-live-bars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.research-live-bar {

    180deg,
    rgb(34 211 238 / 92%),

  );

}

}

@keyframes research-pulse-dot {

  }
  65% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 0%);
  }
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(34 211 238 / 0%);
  }
}

.med-gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--brand-500), var(--accent-500) 72%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/*
 * Accessibility: visible keyboard focus indicator (Requirement 5.4).
 *
 * A single token-driven focus ring is applied to every interactive control,
 * including custom-role widgets. We draw a real `outline` (not just a
 * box-shadow) so the indicator survives Windows High Contrast / forced-colors
 * mode, and layer the soft brand glow on top for the default theme. Focus is
 * only shown for keyboard interaction via `:focus-visible`, so pointer users
 * are not distracted by rings.
 */
:is(
  a[href],
  button,
  input,
  textarea,
  select,
  summary,
  [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
  [contenteditable="true"],
  [role="button"],
  [role="link"],
  [role="tab"],
  [role="menuitem"],
  [role="menuitemcheckbox"],
  [role="menuitemradio"],
  [role="option"],
  [role="switch"],
  [role="checkbox"],
  [role="radio"]
):focus-visible,
.focus-ring:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
}

/* In forced-colors mode the soft glow is dropped; keep the system-drawn ring. */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :is(
    a[href],
    button,
    input,
    textarea,
    select,
    summary,
    [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
    [contenteditable="true"],
    [role="button"],
    [role="link"],
    [role="tab"],
    [role="menuitem"],
    [role="option"],
    [role="switch"],
    [role="checkbox"],
    [role="radio"]
  ):focus-visible,
  .focus-ring:focus-visible {
    outline-color: Highlight;
  }
}

/*
 * Skip link: the first focusable element in the app shell so keyboard users can
 * jump straight to the main content, keeping a logical tab order (Requirement 5.4).
 * It is visually hidden until focused.
 */
.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0.75rem;
  left: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 100;
  transform: translateY(-180%);
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

.skip-link:focus,
.skip-link:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
  outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .skip-link {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@layer components {
  .input {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
    transition:
      border-color 0.15s ease,
      box-shadow 0.15s ease,
      background-color 0.15s ease;
  }
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

.input:hover:not(:disabled):not(:focus) {
  border-color: var(--brand-500);
}

.input:focus,
.input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--brand-600);
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);
}

.input:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background-color: var(--surface-muted);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

html.dark .input,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.7);
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html.dark .input::placeholder,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input::placeholder {
  color: #94a3b8;
}

html.dark .input:focus,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus,
html.dark .input:focus-visible,
html[data-theme="dark"] .input:focus-visible {
  border-color: #38bdf8;
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

html.dark body,
html[data-theme="dark"] body {
  background-image: none;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-white,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-white {
  background-color: rgba(12, 20, 36, 0.9) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .bg-slate-50 {
  background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.58) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .border-slate-200,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .border-slate-200 {
  border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.62) !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-900,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-900 {
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-800,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-800 {
  color: #dbe7f6 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-700,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-700 {
  color: #cdd8ea !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-600,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-600 {
  color: #b2bfd4 !important;
}

html.dark .chrome-shell .text-slate-500,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-shell .text-slate-500 {
  color: #8ea0bc !important;
}

/* CLARA landing inspired by KP3 */
.clara-shell {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  --clara-motion-fast: 160ms;
  --clara-motion-base: 220ms;
  --clara-motion-slow: 360ms;
  --clara-motion-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      74rem 42rem at 50% -24%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18) 36%,
      transparent 76%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 60% 48%,
      rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.08) 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #010611 0%, #010916 26%, #031231 58%, #020a1d 100%);
  background-size:
    auto,
    16px 16px,
    auto;
}

.clara-shell::before,
.clara-shell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.clara-shell::before {
  inset: -32% 54% auto -16%;
  height: 52rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  filter: blur(6px);
}

.clara-shell::after {
  inset: auto -22% -38% 55%;
  height: 46rem;
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
}

.clara-ambient-layers {
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      30rem 16rem at 15% 28%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18),
      transparent 68%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      34rem 18rem at 84% 18%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      20rem 12rem at 70% 66%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
      transparent 68%
    );
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  animation: clara-ambient-shift 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes clara-ambient-shift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(0, -1.8%, 0) scale(1.03);
  }
}

.clara-grid-overlay {
  z-index: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.062) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(66% 56% at 50% 26%, #000 36%, transparent 100%);
  animation: clara-grid-drift 22s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes clara-grid-drift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(16px, 16px, 0);
  }
}

.clara-nav-frame {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.42) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    150deg,
    rgba(6, 18, 45, 0.9),
    rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.94)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 24px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 32px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
}

.clara-nav-link {
  transition:
    color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    background-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    border-color var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-nav-link:hover {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.5);
  color: #d9f6ff;
  background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.28);
}

.clara-wave-top::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 6%;
  right: 6%;
  bottom: -1px;
  height: clamp(20px, 2vw, 34px);
  border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    70% 140% at 50% 100%,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28),
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-panel {
  isolation: isolate;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      90% 74% at 50% -4%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.34),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 36%,
      rgba(8, 20, 49, 0.92) 72%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3, 10, 28, 0.96) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 22, 1) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 48px 110px -62px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.82);
}

.clara-hero-panel::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 8% 3% 8%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.6),
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-hero-constellation {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 9% 7% auto 7%;
  height: 14rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.clara-const-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.6rem;
  height: 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 35%,
    #f0fdff 12%,
    #60a5fa 66%,
    #2563eb 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-const-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 26%;
}
.clara-const-node-b {
  left: 28%;
  top: 12%;
}
.clara-const-node-c {
  right: 20%;
  top: 18%;
}
.clara-const-node-d {
  right: 7%;
  top: 34%;
}

.clara-const-link {
  position: absolute;
  height: 1px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.8),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0)
  );
}

.clara-const-link-a {
  left: 8.4%;
  top: 28.4%;
  width: 24%;
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
}

.clara-const-link-b {
  left: 30.2%;
  top: 14%;
  width: 44%;
  transform: rotate(5deg);
}

.clara-dome-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      116% 92% at 50% -6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.48),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) 34%,
      rgba(8, 16, 38, 0.95) 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.99), rgba(4, 10, 26, 1));
}

.clara-dark-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      92% 80% at 50% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.19),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 18, 42, 0.93), rgba(5, 12, 28, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.08),
    0 30px 58px -40px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92);
}

.clara-model-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      76% 68% at 50% 6%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.22),
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 40%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 23, 53, 0.97), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
    0 30px 60px -44px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.7);
  min-height: 360px;
}

.clara-glass-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.34) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 0% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.16),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(8, 24, 55, 0.86), rgba(5, 13, 31, 0.88)) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    0 26px 48px -34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
    0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-kpi-card {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-card-equal {
  min-height: 430px;
}

.clara-stat-card {
  min-height: 168px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-dark-card,
.clara-model-card {
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .clara-dark-card:hover,
  .clara-model-card:hover,
  .clara-kpi-card:hover,
  .clara-stat-card:hover,
  .clara-glass-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
      0 34px 62px -38px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.66),
      0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24);
  }
}

.clara-neon-button {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.56);
  background: linear-gradient(98deg, #183dbd 0%, #1f58d6 46%, #09649f 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.26),
    0 14px 36px -18px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 28px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    filter var(--clara-motion-fast) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(7, 17, 44, 0.4);
}

.clara-neon-button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -110% auto -110% -42%;
  width: 34%;
  transform: rotate(15deg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)
  );
  opacity: 0.45;
  transition:
    transform var(--clara-motion-slow) var(--clara-motion-ease),
    opacity var(--clara-motion-base) var(--clara-motion-ease);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    0 20px 44px -20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.92),
    0 0 34px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58);
}

.clara-neon-button:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(350%) rotate(15deg);
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.clara-neon-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.clara-display-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 11.2vw, 9rem);
  line-height: 0.97;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 26px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.3),
    0 3px 16px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.62);
}

.clara-sub-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6.4vw, 5.85rem);
  line-height: 1.03;
  letter-spacing: 0.012em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.58);
}

/* Futuristic dashboard utilities */
.futura-panel {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 82%, #60a5fa 18%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(56 189 248 / 10%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(120% 84% at 0% 100%, rgb(16 185 129 / 7%), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 94%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 88%, transparent)
    );
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(118%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 22%),
    0 14px 30px -28px rgb(2 132 199 / 36%);
}

.futura-panel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(125 211 252 / 7%) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 18px 18px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(80% 65% at 50% 15%, #000 30%, transparent 100%);
  opacity: 0.46;
}

.futura-card {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 84%, #60a5fa 16%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, rgb(34 211 238 / 8%), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(
      170deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 90%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -20px rgb(15 23 42 / 22%);
}

.futura-kpi {
  min-height: 132px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 86%, #60a5fa 14%);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 85% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-panel) 96%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 92%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -16px rgb(15 23 42 / 18%);
}

.futura-chip {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--shell-border) 68%, #60a5fa 32%);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-muted) 84%, transparent);
}

html.dark .futura-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .futura-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 100% 0%,
      rgb(34 211 238 / 12%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 84% at 0% 100%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 10%),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(6 12 24 / 90%), rgb(4 10 20 / 92%));
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .futura-card:hover,
  .futura-kpi:hover,
  .futura-panel:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 20%),
      0 14px 26px -20px rgb(14 165 233 / 28%),
      0 0 10px rgb(34 211 238 / 14%);
  }
}

.clara-copy-rhythm {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.45vw + 0.93rem, 1.16rem);
  line-height: clamp(1.78rem, 0.75vw + 1.6rem, 2.12rem);
}

.clara-cta-panel {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.44);
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    rgba(8, 21, 48, 0.8),
    rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.86)
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 26px 64px -44px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9),
    0 0 26px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
}

.clara-cta-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.clara-cta-stack > .clara-neon-button {
  width: min(100%, 23.5rem);
}

.clara-final-cta-panel {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      112% 82% at 50% -12%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16) 45%,
      rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.96) 74%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 20, 46, 0.98), rgba(4, 14, 34, 1));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
    0 40px 90px -58px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.94);
}

.clara-medical-band {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      60rem 28rem at 12% 6%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.24),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      52rem 24rem at 88% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.26),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #051127 0%, #041028 54%, #05152f 100%);
}

.clara-medical-band-soft {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      56rem 30rem at 78% -8%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      42rem 20rem at 16% 100%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #041028 0%, #041128 100%);
}

.clara-medical-panel,
.clara-medical-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(6, 20, 48, 0.88), rgba(3, 12, 30, 0.92)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2),
      transparent 55%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14),
    0 30px 62px -42px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.58);
}

.clara-med-heading {
  color: #f8fcff;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.22),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-copy {
  color: #cbd5e1;
  max-width: 62ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.clara-med-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.46),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16)
  );
  color: #d0f2ff;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.clara-rating-pill {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.35);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.34),
    rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.46)
  );
  padding: 0.36rem 0.72rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: rgba(219, 234, 254, 0.95);
}

.clara-star-icon {
  color: #93c5fd;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.35));
}

.clara-play-button {
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-play-button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -0.65rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35);
  animation: clara-pulse-ring 2.2s ease-out infinite;
  z-index: -1;
}

@keyframes clara-pulse-ring {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.8;
    transform: scale(0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.34);
  }
  70% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.06);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 13px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.06);
  }
}

.clara-medical-bullet {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.5rem;
}

.clara-medical-bullet::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.55rem;
  width: 0.72rem;
  height: 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 0.3rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 58%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      transparent 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 42%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.92) 58%,
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.26), rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.18);
}

.clara-medical-visual {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(13rem, 28vw, 20rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
}

.clara-med-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 21%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 34% 28%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.55) 35%,
    rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.86) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset -16px -14px 28px rgba(8, 47, 122, 0.45),
    0 20px 40px -28px rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.85),
    0 0 42px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
}

.clara-med-ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-med-ring-a {
  inset: 9%;
  transform: rotate(10deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-a 16s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-ring-b {
  inset: 3%;
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.34);
  transform: rotate(-16deg);
  animation: clara-orbit-spin-b 20s linear infinite;
}

.clara-med-cross {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18%;
  right: 11%;
  width: 2.55rem;
  height: 2.55rem;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    rgba(14, 116, 255, 0.96),
    rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.96)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.86);
}

.clara-med-cross::before,
.clara-med-cross::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
}

.clara-med-cross::before {
  top: 50%;
  left: 24%;
  right: 24%;
  height: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-cross::after {
  left: 50%;
  top: 24%;
  bottom: 24%;
  width: 0.27rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.clara-med-node {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.72rem;
  height: 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.4);
}

.clara-med-node-a {
  left: 8%;
  top: 39%;
}

.clara-med-node-b {
  right: 6%;
  top: 45%;
}

.clara-med-node-c {
  left: 24%;
  bottom: 6%;
}

.clara-med-node-d {
  right: 20%;
  bottom: 11%;
}

.clara-data-orbit {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(5.6rem, 14vw, 7.4rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  animation: clara-orbit-breathe 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.clara-data-orbit-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 24%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 35% 30%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
    rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.94) 70%,
    rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.98)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.52);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 42%;
  height: 2px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.88)
  );
}

.clara-data-orbit-link::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -0.35rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0.66rem;
  height: 0.66rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.42);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-a {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(20deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-b {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(138deg);
}

.clara-data-orbit-link-c {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(264deg);
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-a {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(10deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(370deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-spin-b {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(-16deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(-376deg);
  }
}

@keyframes clara-orbit-breathe {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
}

html.dark .clara-medical-panel,
html.dark .clara-medical-card,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .clara-medical-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(5, 16, 38, 0.9), rgba(3, 10, 24, 0.94)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22),
      transparent 55%
    );
}

.clara-section,
.clara-section-strong {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.clara-section::before,
.clara-section-strong::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(92%, 1320px);
  height: 1px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 20%,
    rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.62) 50%,
    rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.46) 80%,
    transparent
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section::after,
.clara-section-strong::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: min(82%, 1040px);
  height: 24px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -60%);
  background: radial-gradient(
    closest-side,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2),
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0)
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.clara-section {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 4.7vw, 7.1rem);
}

.clara-section-strong {
  padding-block: clamp(3.6rem, 5.7vw, 8.2rem);
}

.clara-neon-text {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    #ffffff 0%,
    #e6f8ff 24%,
    #b3edff 48%,
    #93c5fd 76%,
    #60a5fa 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.66),
    0 2px 12px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.5);
}

.dashboard-atmosphere {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.dashboard-atmosphere::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6rem -2rem auto -2rem;
  height: 17rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      58rem 17rem at 90% 8%,
      rgb(14 165 233 / 18%),
      transparent 65%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      44rem 16rem at 8% 32%,
      rgb(13 148 136 / 14%),
      transparent 72%
    );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.dashboard-atmosphere::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 24% 12%,
      rgb(59 130 246 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.3px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 76% 72%,
      rgb(20 184 166 / 8%) 1px,
      transparent 1.3px
    );
  background-size:
    24px 24px,
    22px 22px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.54;
}

.dashboard-fade-up {
  animation: dashboard-fade-up 230ms ease-out both;
}

.dashboard-holo-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      165deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8),
      rgba(248, 252, 255, 0.72)
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
      transparent 58%
    );
  box-shadow:
    0 24px 66px -44px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
}

html.dark .dashboard-holo-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-holo-panel {
  background:
    linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(8, 16, 30, 0.9), rgba(5, 12, 24, 0.88)),
    radial-gradient(
      120% 100% at 100% 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18),
      transparent 58%
    );
}

.dashboard-strip-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88),
      rgba(247, 252, 255, 0.78)
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    );
  box-shadow: 0 18px 52px -40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.48);
}

html.dark .dashboard-strip-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-strip-panel {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 16, 30, 0.88), rgba(7, 14, 28, 0.82)),
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.2) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    );
}

.dashboard-side-panel {
  background: var(--dashboard-side-panel-bg);
  box-shadow:
    0 14px 42px -34px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.52),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34);
}

.dashboard-live-pill {
  color: var(--text-brand);
  border-color: var(--shell-border-strong);
  background: linear-gradient(
    140deg,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14),
    rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.12)
  );
}

.dashboard-live-pill::before {
  content: "";
  width: 0.45rem;
  height: 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-right: 0.4rem;
  background: currentColor;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.42);
  animation: dashboard-live-pulse 1.8s ease-out infinite;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="1"] {
  animation-delay: 45ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="2"] {
  animation-delay: 80ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="3"] {
  animation-delay: 115ms;
}

.dashboard-fade-up[data-delay="4"] {
  animation-delay: 150ms;
}

@keyframes dashboard-fade-up {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes dashboard-live-pulse {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.42);
  }
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .clara-ambient-layers,
  .clara-grid-overlay,
  .clara-neon-button::before,
  .clara-play-button::after,
  .clara-med-ring-a,
  .clara-med-ring-b,
  .clara-data-orbit,
  .dashboard-fade-up,
  .dashboard-live-pill::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .clara-rating-pill {
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    padding: 0.32rem 0.65rem;
  }

  .clara-grid-overlay {
    background-size: 26px 26px;
  }

  .clara-hero-constellation {
    display: none;
  }

  .clara-hero-panel {
    border-radius: 1.35rem;
  }

  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 14.5vw, 4.2rem);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 11vw, 3.1rem);
    line-height: 1.04;
  }

  .clara-copy-rhythm {
    font-size: 0.99rem;
    line-height: 1.78rem;
  }

  .clara-cta-panel .clara-neon-button,
  .clara-cta-stack > .clara-neon-button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .clara-section::after,
  .clara-section-strong::after {
    width: min(94%, 420px);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(2.7rem, 9.6vw, 3.5rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 11.2vw, 4rem);
  }

  .clara-kpi-card,
  .clara-model-card,
  .clara-card-equal,
  .clara-stat-card {
    min-height: unset;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(4.2rem, 10.5vw, 6.9rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 6.6vw, 4.6rem);
  }

  .clara-copy-rhythm {
    font-size: clamp(1.03rem, 0.85vw + 0.74rem, 1.14rem);
    line-height: clamp(1.86rem, 1.35vw + 1.45rem, 2.08rem);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 6.8vw, 5rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(4rem, 7.6vw, 5.8rem);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-width: 1535px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(6rem, 7vw, 7.8rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(3.7rem, 5.3vw, 5.4rem);
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(4.1rem, 5vw, 6.2rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(4.7rem, 5.8vw, 7rem);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1536px) {
  .clara-display-title {
    font-size: clamp(7.2rem, 7.5vw, 9.8rem);
  }

  .clara-sub-display {
    font-size: clamp(4.9rem, 4.9vw, 6.3rem);
  }

  .clara-model-card {
    min-height: 390px;
  }

  .clara-card-equal {
    min-height: 465px;
  }

  .clara-stat-card {
    min-height: 198px;
  }

  .clara-section {
    padding-block: clamp(5.2rem, 4.6vw, 7.4rem);
  }

  .clara-section-strong {
    padding-block: clamp(6rem, 5vw, 8.5rem);
  }
}

/* Keep legacy feature surfaces visually aligned after their older declarations. */
.clara-glass-panel,
.glass-card,
.glass-surface-1,
.glass-surface-2,
.glass-surface-3,
.chrome-panel,
.research-panel-modern,
.dashboard-holo-panel,
.dashboard-strip-panel,
.dashboard-side-panel,
html.dark .chrome-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .chrome-panel,
html.dark .research-panel-modern,
html[data-theme="dark"] .research-panel-modern,
html.dark .dashboard-holo-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-holo-panel,
html.dark .dashboard-strip-panel,
html[data-theme="dark"] .dashboard-strip-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
  background: var(--surface-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

.chrome-shell::before,
.research-workspace::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::before,
.dashboard-atmosphere::after {
  display: none;
}

.research-hero-heading,
.med-gradient-text {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: none;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
}
```

```
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const styles = readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), "styles/globals.css"), "utf8");

describe("CLARA Chat theme integration", () => {
  it("inherits the application canvas and sidebar tokens in every theme", () => {
    const chatRule = styles.match(
      /\n\.clara-chat-v2 \{\n([\s\S]*?)\n\}/,
    )?.[1];

    expect(chatRule).toBeDefined();
    expect(chatRule).not.toMatch(/--bg-canvas\s*:/);
    expect(chatRule).not.toMatch(/--surface-sidebar\s*:/);
    expect(chatRule).toContain("var(--bg-canvas)");
  });

  it("uses the resolved dark canvas without a light fallback", () => {

    );
  });
});
```

```
import MessageLog from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/MessageLog";
import Composer from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/Composer";
import ChatWelcome from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/ChatWelcome";
import CommandPaletteLazy from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/CommandPaletteLazy";
import WorkspaceDrawerLazy from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/WorkspaceDrawerLazy";
import TelemetryPanelLazy from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/TelemetryPanelLazy";
import { Badge, IconButton } from "@/app/chat/_v2/components/primitives";
import { usePrefersReducedMotion } from "@/app/chat/_v2/theme/usePrefersReducedMotion";
import { useResolvedTheme } from "@/app/chat/_v2/theme/useResolvedTheme";

/**
 * ChatShell — the rebuilt CLARA Chat (CHAT_V2) layout + orchestration.
 *
 * Owns responsive layout (sidebar / canvas / drawer), ARIA landmarks, a
 * skip-link, global keyboard shortcuts, and focus management (Requirement 2.1,
 * 5.1, 5.2). It composes the colocated hooks and presentational components; it
 * reuses the EXISTING API/SSE contracts unchanged (Requirement 8.3) and
 * preserves the persistent medical disclaimer (Requirement 8.4) and admin-only
 * telemetry detail (Requirement 6.6).
 */

/** Stable id of the composer textarea (see `Composer.tsx`), used for focus. */
const COMPOSER_INPUT_ID = "chat-composer-input";

/** Stable id of the sidebar search field (see `ConversationSidebar.tsx`). */
const SEARCH_INPUT_ID = "chat-v2-search";

export default function ChatShell() {
  const [uiLanguage, setUiLanguage] = useState<UILanguage>("vi");
  const [role, setRole] = useState<UserRole>("normal");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ResearchExecutionMode>("fast");
  const [retrievalStackMode, setRetrievalStackMode] =
    useState<ResearchRetrievalStackMode>("auto");
  const [personalMode, setPersonalMode] = useState(false);

  const [activeConversationId, setActiveConversationId] = useState<
    number | null
  >(null);
  const [activeMeta, setActiveMeta] =
    useState<WorkspaceConversationItem | null>(null);
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<
    WorkspaceConversationItem[] | null
  >(null);
  const [isWorkspaceOpen, setIsWorkspaceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMobileSidebarOpen, setIsMobileSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAppMenuOpen, setIsAppMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  const conversations = useConversations();
  const turns = useChatTurns();
  const stream = useChatStream();
  const workspace = useWorkspace({
    apiUnavailable: conversations.apiUnavailable,
  });

  // the app's shared token layer (`lib/theme.ts` + `globals.css`); the shell
  // observes the resolved theme so it can expose it to assistive tech and child
  // surfaces, and reflects the `prefers-reduced-motion` preference on the root
  // so decorative motion can be neutralized consistently.
  const resolvedTheme = useResolvedTheme();
  const prefersReducedMotion = usePrefersReducedMotion();

  // Focus management for the composer (Requirement 5.1, 5.4). The composer is a
  // self-contained presentational component, so the shell focuses it by its
  // stable input id rather than threading a ref through the component tree.
  const focusComposer = useCallback(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById(COMPOSER_INPUT_ID);
    if (el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) el.focus();
  }, []);

  const chooseStarterPrompt = useCallback(
    (prompt: string) => {
      setQuery(prompt);
      window.setTimeout(focusComposer, 0);
    },
    [focusComposer],
  );

  const launchResearch = useCallback(
    (sourceQuery: string) => {
      setMode("deep_beta");
      setQuery(sourceQuery);
      setNotice(
        uiLanguage === "en"
          ? "Research mode is ready. Refine the question or run it now."
          : "Đã sẵn sàng chế độ Nghiên cứu. Bạn có thể chỉnh câu hỏi hoặc chạy ngay.",
      );
      window.setTimeout(focusComposer, 0);
    },
    [focusComposer, uiLanguage],
  );

  // Focus the sidebar conversation-search field (command-palette parity action
  // + Ctrl/⌘+K). On mobile the sidebar is an overlay, so open it first so the
  // field is visible before focus lands (Requirement 5.1, 6.4).
  const focusSearch = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMobileSidebarOpen(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(SEARCH_INPUT_ID);
      if (el instanceof HTMLInputElement) el.focus();
    }, 10);
  }, []);

  const isEn = uiLanguage === "en";
  const appNavItems = useMemo(() => getNavItemsByRole(role), [role]);
  // User-facing mode label (Req 4.4): never expose the internal mode string,
  // always present the Vietnamese End_User label via the shared mapping.
  const activeModeLabel = useMemo(() => toModeLabel(mode), [mode]);
  const latestAnswer = useMemo(
    () => latestAnswerFromTurn(turns.turns[turns.turns.length - 1] ?? null),
    [turns.turns],
  );
  const latestTier2Result = useMemo(() => {
    const found = [...turns.turns]
      .reverse()
      .find((item) => item.result.tier === "tier2");
    return found && found.result.tier === "tier2" ? found.result : null;
  }, [turns.turns]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setUiLanguage(getStoredUILanguage());
    setRole(getRole());
    return onUILanguageChange((language) => setUiLanguage(language));
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    const nextTheme: ThemePreference =
      resolvedTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    saveThemePreference(nextTheme);
    applyThemePreference(nextTheme);
  }, [resolvedTheme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void conversations.load();
    void workspace.loadNotes();
    void workspace.loadShares();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {

    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setNotice(""), 2500);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [notice]);

  // --- Debounced workspace search -------------------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    const keyword = searchText.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      setSearchResults(null);

    }
    let active = true;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await searchWorkspace(keyword, 16);
        if (active) setSearchResults(result.conversations);
      } catch {
        if (active) setSearchResults(null);
      }
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      active = false;
      window.clearTimeout(timer);

  }, [searchText]);

    }

  const togglePersonalMode = useCallback(() => {

      if (next) setMode((m) => (m === "fast" ? "deep" : m));
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // --- Conversation selection -----------------------------------------------
  const selectConversation = useCallback(
    async (item: WorkspaceConversationItem) => {
      const conversationId = asConversationId(item.conversation_id);
      if (!conversationId) return;
      setActiveConversationId(conversationId);
      setActiveMeta(item);
      setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
      setError("");
      const cached = turns.cachedTurns(conversationId);
      if (cached.length) turns.setActive(cached);
      try {
        await turns.load(conversationId);
      } catch (cause) {
        setError(

        } catch {
          // best-effort
        }
      }
    },
    [conversations.apiUnavailable, turns],
  );

  const newChat = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveConversationId(null);
    setActiveMeta(null);
    turns.clear();
    setQuery("");
    setError("");
    setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
    window.setTimeout(() => focusComposer(), 10);
  }, [turns, focusComposer]);

  // Stable handlers for opening advanced surfaces, so memoized children
  // (ConversationSidebar) don't re-render on every shell state change and the
  // lazy surfaces only mount on demand (Requirement 7.2, 7.3, Property P9).
  const openWorkspace = useCallback(() => setIsWorkspaceOpen(true), []);
  const openMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => setIsMobileSidebarOpen(true), []);
  const closeWorkspace = useCallback(() => setIsWorkspaceOpen(false), []);
  const openFoldersFromSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
    setIsWorkspaceOpen(true);
  }, []);

  // --- Submit ---------------------------------------------------------------
  const onSubmit = useCallback(
    async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const message = query.trim();
      if (!message || stream.isRunning) return;
      setError("");

      const transport = resolveChatTransport(mode);
      // Coarse, non-PII analytics only (Requirement 8.5).
      trackChatMessageSent({ mode, transport });

      try {
        const result = await stream.run(message, {
          mode,
          retrievalStackMode,
          personalMode,
          uiLanguage,
        });

        const localTurn = createConversationItem(message, result, {
          id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
        });
        // Append to the visible log + local cache exactly once (Property P4).
        turns.appendTurn(activeConversationId, localTurn);

        let targetId = activeConversationId;
        try {
          if (targetId) {
            const persisted = await appendResearchConversationMessage(
              targetId,
              message,
              result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
            );
            targetId = asConversationId(Number(persisted.id));
          } else {
            const persisted = await createResearchConversation(
              message,
              result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
            );
            targetId = asConversationId(Number(persisted.id));
          }
        } catch (persistError) {
          // Local-fallback: keep the turn cached against a synthetic id so it is
          // never lost when persistence fails (Requirement 3.3, 6.5).
          const fallbackId = targetId ?? Date.now();
          targetId = fallbackId;
          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          conversations.upsertLocal({
            conversation_id: fallbackId,
            title: message.slice(0, 255),
            preview: message.slice(0, 260),
            query_id: null,
            message_count: Math.max(1, (activeMeta?.message_count ?? 0) + 1),
            created_at: activeMeta?.created_at ?? nowIso,
            last_message_at: nowIso,
            folder_id: activeMeta?.folder_id ?? null,
            channel_id: null,
            is_favorite: activeMeta?.is_favorite ?? false,
          });
          turns.appendTurn(fallbackId, localTurn);
          setNotice(
            isEn
              ? "Answer saved locally; backend sync will recover later."
              : "Đã lưu local; backend sync sẽ khôi phục sau.",
          );
        }

        if (targetId) {
          setActiveConversationId(targetId);
          if (!conversations.apiUnavailable) {
            try {
              await turns.load(targetId);
            } catch {
              // keep local turns
            }
          }
        }

        setQuery("");
        await Promise.all([conversations.load(), workspace.loadShares()]);
      } catch (cause) {
        if (cause instanceof DOMException && cause.name === "AbortError") {
          setNotice(isEn ? "Run cancelled." : "Đã hủy phiên.");
          return;
        }
        setError(
          cause instanceof Error
            ? sanitizeUpstreamError(cause.message)
            : isEn
              ? "Could not process the question."
              : "Không thể xử lý câu hỏi.",
        );
      }
    },
    [
      activeConversationId,
      activeMeta,
      conversations,
      isEn,
      mode,
      personalMode,
      query,
      retrievalStackMode,
      role,
      stream,
      turns,
      uiLanguage,
      workspace,
    ],
  );

  const copyShareUrl = useCallback(
    async (url: string) => {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
        setNotice(isEn ? "Copied." : "Đã sao chép.");
      } catch {
        window.prompt("Copy", url);
      }
    },
    [isEn],
  );

  // --- Command palette -------------------------------------------------------
  const commandActions = useMemo<CommandAction[]>(() => {
    const canExport = Boolean(asConversationId(activeConversationId));
    return [
      {
        id: "new-chat",
        label: isEn ? "New chat" : "Chat mới",
        hint: "Ctrl/⌘+Shift+N",
        keywords: ["new", "chat", "conversation", "moi"],
        run: newChat,
      },
      {
        id: "focus-composer",
        label: isEn ? "Focus composer" : "Nhập câu hỏi",
        hint: "/",
        keywords: ["focus", "composer", "prompt", "input"],
        run: () => focusComposer(),
      },
      {
        id: "search-conversations",
        label: isEn ? "Search conversations" : "Tìm hội thoại",
        keywords: ["search", "find", "conversation", "tim", "workspace"],
        run: () => focusSearch(),
      },
      {
        id: "open-workspace",
        label: isEn ? "Open workspace" : "Mở workspace",
        keywords: ["workspace", "notes", "shares", "drawer", "folders"],
        run: () => setIsWorkspaceOpen(true),
      },
      {
        id: "mode-fast",
        label: isEn ? "Mode: Quick" : "Chế độ: Nhanh",
        keywords: ["mode", "fast", "quick", "nhanh"],
        run: () => applyMode("fast"),
      },
      {
        id: "mode-deep",
        label: isEn ? "Mode: Reason" : "Chế độ: Tư duy",
        keywords: ["mode", "deep", "reason", "tu duy"],
        run: () => applyMode("deep"),
      },
      {
        id: "mode-deep-beta",
        label: isEn ? "Mode: Pro" : "Chế độ: Pro",
        keywords: ["mode", "deep_beta", "pro"],
        run: () => applyMode("deep_beta"),
      },
      {
        id: "toggle-personal",
        label: personalMode
          ? isEn
            ? "Personal mode: turn off"
            : "Chế độ cá nhân: tắt"
          : isEn
            ? "Personal mode: turn on"
            : "Chế độ cá nhân: bật",
        keywords: ["personal", "phr", "ca nhan", "private", "toggle"],
        run: () => togglePersonalMode(),
      },
      {
        id: "export-docx",
        label: isEn ? "Export report (DOCX)" : "Xuất báo cáo (DOCX)",
        keywords: ["export", "docx", "word", "report"],
        disabled: !canExport,
        run: () => {
          const id = asConversationId(activeConversationId);
          if (id) {
            void workspace.exportConversation(
              id,
              "docx",
              turns.turns,
              activeMeta?.title || `Conversation ${id}`,
            );
          }
        },
      },
      {
        id: "export-md",
        label: isEn ? "Export Markdown" : "Xuất Markdown",
        keywords: ["export", "markdown", "md"],
        disabled: !canExport,
        run: () => {
          const id = asConversationId(activeConversationId);
          if (id) {
            void workspace.exportConversation(
              id,
              "markdown",
              turns.turns,
              activeMeta?.title || `Conversation ${id}`,
            );
          }
        },
      },
      {
        id: "share",
        label: isEn ? "Create share link" : "Tạo liên kết chia sẻ",
        keywords: ["share", "public", "link"],
        disabled: !canExport || conversations.apiUnavailable,
        run: () => {
          const id = asConversationId(activeConversationId);
          if (id) {
            void workspace.share(id).then((rows) => {
              const created = rows?.find((row) => row.conversation_id === id);
              if (created) void copyShareUrl(created.public_url);
            });
          }
        },
      },
      {
        id: "save-note",
        label: isEn
          ? "Save latest answer as note"
          : "Lưu câu trả lời thành ghi chú",
        keywords: ["note", "save", "answer"],
        disabled: !latestAnswer.trim(),
        run: () => {
          void workspace
            .saveNote({
              title: (
                turns.turns[turns.turns.length - 1]?.query ?? "Note"
              ).slice(0, 90),
              contentMarkdown: latestAnswer,
              tags: ["answer", "auto"],
              conversationId: asConversationId(activeConversationId),
            })
            .then(() => setNotice(isEn ? "Note saved." : "Đã lưu ghi chú."));
        },
      },
    ];
  }, [
    activeConversationId,
    activeMeta,
    applyMode,
    conversations.apiUnavailable,
    copyShareUrl,
    focusComposer,
    focusSearch,
    isEn,
    latestAnswer,
    newChat,
    personalMode,
    togglePersonalMode,
    turns.turns,
    workspace,
  ]);

  const palette = useCommandPalette(commandActions);

  // --- Global keyboard shortcuts --------------------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
      const withCommand = event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey;
      if (palette.isOpen) return;
      if (
        (withCommand && event.shiftKey && key === "p") ||
        (withCommand && key === "k")
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();
        palette.open();
        return;
      }
      if (withCommand && event.shiftKey && key === "n") {
        event.preventDefault();
        newChat();
        return;
      }
      if (
        !withCommand &&
        !event.altKey &&
        key === "/" &&
        !isEditableElement(event.target)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();
        focusComposer();
        return;
      }
      if (key === "escape") {
        setIsWorkspaceOpen(false);
        setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [newChat, palette, focusComposer]);

  return (
    <div
      data-resolved-theme={resolvedTheme}
      data-reduced-motion={prefersReducedMotion ? "true" : "false"}
      style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-chat)" }}
      className="clara-chat-v2 relative flex h-[calc(100dvh-8.2rem)] min-h-[36rem] flex-col bg-[var(--bg-canvas)] text-[var(--text-primary)] motion-reduce:transition-none lg:h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] [&_*]:motion-reduce:!animate-none"
    >
      <a
        href="#chat-v2-main"
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:absolute focus:left-2 focus:top-2 focus:z-[80] focus:rounded-lg focus:bg-[var(--brand-600)] focus:px-3 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:font-semibold focus:text-white"
      >
        {isEn ? "Skip to conversation" : "Tới khung trò chuyện"}
      </a>

      <div className="grid h-full min-h-0 grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-[18rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        {/* Sidebar (overlay on mobile, fixed column on desktop). */}
        {isMobileSidebarOpen ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={isEn ? "Close sidebar" : "Đóng sidebar"}
            onClick={() => setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-slate-950/45 backdrop-blur-[2px] xl:hidden"
          />
        ) : null}
        <aside
          className={[
            "fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-[min(86vw,18rem)] border-r border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-panel)] transition-transform duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none xl:relative xl:z-0 xl:w-auto xl:translate-x-0",
            isMobileSidebarOpen
              ? "translate-x-0"
              : "-translate-x-[110%] xl:translate-x-0",
          ].join(" ")}
        >
          <ConversationSidebar
            conversations={displayedConversations}
            activeId={activeConversationId}
            isLoading={conversations.isLoading}
            searchText={searchText}
            onSearchChange={setSearchText}
            onSelect={selectConversation}
            onNewChat={newChat}
            onOpenFolders={openFoldersFromSidebar}
            uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
          />
        </aside>

        {/* Main canvas. */}
        <main
          id="chat-v2-main"
          className="flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden"
          aria-label={isEn ? "Conversation canvas" : "Khung trò chuyện"}
        >
          <header className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-panel)]/95 px-3 py-2 backdrop-blur-lg">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
              <IconButton
                label={isEn ? "Open sidebar" : "Mở sidebar"}
                icon="menu"
                className="xl:hidden"
                onClick={openMobileSidebar}
              />
              <h1 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {activeMeta?.title?.trim() || "CLARA"}
              </h1>
              <Badge tone="info">{activeModeLabel}</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <nav
                aria-label={isEn ? "Primary navigation" : "Điều hướng chính"}
                className="hidden items-center gap-1 md:flex"
              >
                <Link
                  href="/dashboard"
                  className="rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition hover:bg-[var(--surface-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]"
                >
                  {isEn ? "Dashboard" : "Tổng quan"}
                </Link>
                <Link
                  href="/research"
                  className="rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition hover:bg-[var(--surface-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]"
                >
                  {isEn ? "Research" : "Nghiên cứu"}
                </Link>
              </nav>
              <IconButton
                label={
                  resolvedTheme === "dark"
                    ? isEn
                      ? "Switch to light mode"
                      : "Chuyển sang giao diện sáng"
                    : isEn
                      ? "Switch to dark mode"
                      : "Chuyển sang giao diện tối"
                }
                icon={resolvedTheme === "dark" ? "light_mode" : "dark_mode"}
                onClick={toggleTheme}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={isEn ? "Open all tools" : "Mở các công cụ"}
                aria-expanded={isAppMenuOpen}
                title={isEn ? "All tools" : "Các công cụ"}
                onClick={() => setIsAppMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
                className="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[color:var(--shell-border)] px-2.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition hover:bg-[var(--surface-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[color:var(--brand-500)]"
              >
                <span
                  className="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  apps
                </span>
                <span className="hidden text-xs font-semibold sm:inline">
                  {isEn ? "Tools" : "Công cụ"}
                </span>
              </button>
              <IconButton
                label={isEn ? "Command palette" : "Bảng lệnh"}
                icon="bolt"
                onClick={palette.open}
              />
              <IconButton
                label={isEn ? "Open workspace" : "Mở workspace"}
                icon="dock_to_left"
                onClick={openWorkspace}
              />
            </div>
          </header>

          {isAppMenuOpen ? (
            <div
              className="absolute right-3 top-[3.35rem] z-30 w-[min(92vw,22rem)] rounded-2xl border border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-panel)] p-2 shadow-xl shadow-slate-950/10"
              role="dialog"
              aria-label={isEn ? "CLARA tools" : "Công cụ CLARA"}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  {isEn ? "CLARA tools" : "Công cụ CLARA"}
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAppMenuOpen(false)}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]"
                >
                  {isEn ? "Close" : "Đóng"}
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-1 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {appNavItems.map((item) => (
                  <Link
                    key={item.href}
                    href={item.href}
                    onClick={() => setIsAppMenuOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 text-left hover:bg-[var(--surface-muted)]"
                  >
                    <span
                      className="material-symbols-outlined mt-0.5 text-[18px] text-[var(--text-brand)]"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                      {item.icon}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                        {item.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                        {item.desc}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[color:var(--shell-border)] px-2 pt-2">
                <Link
                  href="/account/data"
                  onClick={() => setIsAppMenuOpen(false)}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]"
                >
                  {isEn ? "Account" : "Tài khoản"}
                </Link>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => beginLogout()}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--status-danger-text)]"
                >
                  {isEn ? "Sign out" : "Đăng xuất"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {/* Persistent medical disclaimer (Requirement 8.4). */}
          <p
            role="note"
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border-b border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-panel)] px-3 py-1.5 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]"
          >
            <span
              className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              info
            </span>
            {isEn
              ? "CLARA is an AI health information assistant, not a replacement for a clinician."
              : "CLARA là AI hỗ trợ thông tin y tế, không thay thế bác sĩ hoặc nhân viên y tế."}
          </p>

          {error ? (
            <p
              role="alert"
              className="border-b border-[color:var(--status-danger-border)] bg-[var(--status-danger-bg)] px-3 py-2 text-[12px] font-medium text-[var(--status-danger-text)]"
            >
              {error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {notice ? (
            <p
              aria-live="polite"
              className="border-b border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-muted)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            >
              {notice}
            </p>
          ) : null}

          {turns.turns.length ? (
            <MessageLog
              turns={turns.turns}
              uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
              isRunning={stream.isRunning}
              role={role}
              onLaunchResearch={launchResearch}
            />
          ) : (
            <ChatWelcome
              role={role}
              uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
              onChoosePrompt={chooseStarterPrompt}
            />
          )}

          {role === "admin" && latestTier2Result ? (
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-3 pb-2">
              <TelemetryPanelLazy
                role={role}
                result={latestTier2Result}
                uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
              />
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <Composer
            query={query}
            onChangeQuery={setQuery}
            onSubmit={onSubmit}
            isRunning={stream.isRunning}
            onCancel={stream.cancel}
            mode={mode}
            onChangeMode={applyMode}
            retrievalStackMode={retrievalStackMode}
            onChangeRetrievalStackMode={setRetrievalStackMode}
            personalMode={personalMode}
            onTogglePersonalMode={togglePersonalMode}
            liveStatusNote={stream.statusNote}
            uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
            userRole={role}
          />
        </main>
      </div>

      <CommandPaletteLazy palette={palette} uiLanguage={uiLanguage} />
      <WorkspaceDrawerLazy
        open={isWorkspaceOpen}
        onClose={closeWorkspace}
        workspace={workspace}
        uiLanguage={uiLanguage}
        onCopyShareUrl={copyShareUrl}
        activeConversationId={activeConversationId}
        activeTitle={activeMeta?.title || ""}
        activeTurns={turns.turns}
        apiUnavailable={conversations.apiUnavailable}
        onNotice={setNotice}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

```

```
  role: UserRole;

export default function MobileBottomNav({ role }: MobileBottomNavProps) {

  if (pathname === "/research" || pathname.startsWith("/research/")) {
    return null;
  }
  const items = getMobilePrimaryNav(role);

  return (
    <nav className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-40 border-t border-[color:var(--shell-border)] bg-[var(--surface-header)] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)] lg:hidden" aria-label="Điều hướng chính">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-1 py-1">
        <ul
          className="grid gap-1.5"
          style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${Math.max(items.length, 1)}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}
        >
          {items.map((item) => {
            const active = isActiveRoute(pathname, item.href);
            return (
              <li key={item.href}>
                <Link
                  href={item.href}
                  aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={`chrome-nav-link flex min-h-[56px] flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5 text-center transition ${
                    active
                      ? "border-[color:var(--shell-border-strong)] bg-[var(--surface-brand-soft)] text-[var(--text-brand)]"
                      : "border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:border-[color:var(--shell-border)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-muted)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]" aria-hidden="true">
                    {item.icon}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold leading-tight">{item.label}</span>
                  <span className={`mt-1 h-0.5 w-5 rounded-full transition ${active ? "bg-[var(--text-brand)]" : "bg-transparent"}`} />
                </Link>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

const ACCESS_COOKIE_NAME =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_ACCESS_COOKIE ?? "clara_access_token";
const REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_REFRESH_COOKIE ?? "clara_refresh_token";
const CLIENT_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_CLIENT_SESSION_COOKIE ?? "clara_client_session";
const AUTH_BYPASS_ENABLED =
  process.env.AUTH_BYPASS === "true" ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_BYPASS === "true";

const PUBLIC_PATHS = new Set([
  "/",
  "/legal",
  "/legal/privacy",
  "/legal/terms",
  "/legal/consent",
  "/legal/cookies",
  "/login",
  "/register",
  "/logout",
  "/forgot-password",
  "/reset-password",
  "/verify-email",
  "/huong-dan",
]);

function isPublicPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  if (PUBLIC_PATHS.has(pathname)) return true;
  if (pathname.startsWith("/share/")) return true;
  return (
    pathname.startsWith("/_next") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/api") ||
    pathname.includes(".")
  );
}

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;
  if (AUTH_BYPASS_ENABLED) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  const hasSession = Boolean(
    request.cookies.get(ACCESS_COOKIE_NAME)?.value ||
    request.cookies.get(REFRESH_COOKIE_NAME)?.value ||
    // This browser-written cookie is only a routing hint. It never grants API
    // access: AppShell immediately validates protected pages through /auth/me.
    // Keeping it here lets cookie-backed sessions recover through /auth/refresh
    // instead of being rejected by the edge before client hydration.
    request.cookies.get(CLIENT_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value,
  );

  if (isPublicPath(pathname)) {
    // The landing and authentication forms are always reachable. A stale
    // client-side session hint must never skip the login form; the API is the
    // authority and the form can safely re-authenticate or switch accounts.
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  if (!hasSession) {
    const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
    loginUrl.searchParams.set("next", `${pathname}${search}`);
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)"],
};
```

```
            email=normalized_email,

        )

        db.refresh(user)

    if user is None or not verify_password(payload.password, user.hashed_password):
        login_guard.register_failure(login_key)
```
