            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Sai email hoặc mật khẩu",
        )

    if user.status != "active":

            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,

        return LoginResponse(

@router.post("/login-otp/verify", response_model=LoginResponse)
def verify_login_otp(
    payload: LoginOtpVerifyRequest,
    request: Request,
    response: Response,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> LoginResponse:
    _cleanup_auth_tokens(db)
    normalized_email = _normalize_email(payload.email)
    _ensure_action_rate_limit(
        "login_otp_verify",
        f"{normalized_email}|{_extract_client_ip(request)}",
    )

    user = db.execute(select(User).where(User.email == normalized_email)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Mã OTP không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn",
        )
    if user.status != "active":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Tài khoản đang bị khóa hoặc chưa sẵn sàng",
        )

    otp_code = payload.otp_code.strip()
    if not otp_code:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Thiếu mã OTP")

    token_record = _consume_action_token(
        db,
        raw_token=otp_code,
        token_type="login_otp",
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    if not token_record:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Mã OTP không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn",
        )

    role = user.role if user.role in {"normal", "researcher", "doctor", "admin"} else "normal"
    access_token = create_access_token(subject=user.email, role=role)
    refresh_token = _issue_refresh_session_token(db, user=user)
    user.last_login_at = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    _set_auth_cookies(response, access_token=access_token, refresh_token=refresh_token)
    return LoginResponse(
        access_token=access_token,
        refresh_token=refresh_token,
        role=role,
    )

import logging
import os

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker

from clara_api.core.config import get_settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_DEFAULT_FALLBACK_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite+pysqlite:////data/clara.db"
_TRUE_VALUES = {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _engine_kwargs_for(url: str, settings=None) -> dict[str, object]:
    if settings is None:
        settings = get_settings()
    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {"pool_pre_ping": bool(settings.db_pool_pre_ping)}
    if url.startswith("sqlite"):
        # SQLite uses a non-QueuePool by default; the QueuePool sizing knobs do
        # not apply, so only the connect_args/pre_ping behavior is preserved.
        kwargs["connect_args"] = {"check_same_thread": False}
    else:
        # Apply connection-pool sizing for server-backed databases. Defaults equal
        # SQLAlchemy's own defaults, so an unconfigured deployment is unchanged.
        kwargs["pool_size"] = settings.db_pool_size
        kwargs["max_overflow"] = settings.db_max_overflow
        kwargs["pool_timeout"] = settings.db_pool_timeout
        if settings.db_pool_recycle >= 0:
            kwargs["pool_recycle"] = settings.db_pool_recycle
    return kwargs


def _bool_from_env(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in _TRUE_VALUES


def _fallback_enabled() -> bool:
    if "DATABASE_FALLBACK_ENABLED" in os.environ:
        return _bool_from_env("DATABASE_FALLBACK_ENABLED", default=False)
    if "DB_ALLOW_SQLITE_FALLBACK" in os.environ:
        return _bool_from_env("DB_ALLOW_SQLITE_FALLBACK", default=False)
    return False


def _is_production_environment(environment: str) -> bool:
    return environment.strip().lower() in {"prod", "production"}


def _probe_connection(engine_obj) -> None:
    with engine_obj.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("SELECT 1"))


def _resolve_fallback_url() -> str:
    configured = os.getenv("DATABASE_FALLBACK_URL", "").strip()
    return configured or _DEFAULT_FALLBACK_DATABASE_URL


def _build_engine():
    settings = get_settings()
    primary_url = settings.database_url
    primary_engine = create_engine(primary_url, **_engine_kwargs_for(primary_url, settings))
    try:
        _probe_connection(primary_engine)
        return primary_engine
    except Exception as exc:
        is_production = _is_production_environment(settings.environment)

  if [[ -n "${csrf_cookie_line}" ]]; then

COMPOSE=(

  -f "${ROOT_DIR}/deploy/docker/docker-compose.app.yml"
)

bridge_api_to_postgres_network() {
  local postgres_container="${POSTGRES_CONTAINER_NAME:-clara-postgres}"
  local api_container_id
  local postgres_container_id
  local network

  api_container_id="$("${COMPOSE[@]}" ps -q api 2>/dev/null || true)"
  postgres_container_id="$(docker ps -q -f "name=^/${postgres_container}$" 2>/dev/null || true)"

  if [[ -z "${api_container_id}" || -z "${postgres_container_id}" ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  while IFS= read -r network; do
    [[ -z "${network}" ]] && continue
    docker network connect "${network}" "${api_container_id}" 2>/dev/null || true
  done < <(docker inspect -f '{{range $k, $v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "${postgres_container_id}")
}

wait_json() {
  local url="$1"
  local pattern="$2"
  local attempts="${3:-20}"
  local sleep_seconds="${4:-2}"

  for ((i=1; i<=attempts; i++)); do
    if output="$(curl -fsSL "${url}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
      if [[ "${output}" == *"${pattern}"* ]]; then
        echo "[health] ok ${url}"
        return 0
      fi
    fi
    echo "[health] waiting ${url} (${i}/${attempts})"
    sleep "${sleep_seconds}"
  done

  echo "[health] failed ${url} did not contain pattern: ${pattern}" >&2
  return 1
}

SMOKE_RESEARCH_FAIL_REASON=""

smoke_research_mode() {
  local ml_url="$1"
  local research_mode="$2"
  local output_file="$3"
  local require_deepseek="$4"
  local last_reason="no successful attempt"

  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    local curl_args=()
    if [[ -n "${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE}" ]]; then
      curl_args+=(-H "X-ML-Internal-Key: ${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE}")

      :
    else
      local curl_exit="$?"
      last_reason="transport_error (curl_exit=${curl_exit})"
      echo "[smoke] ${research_mode} attempt ${attempt} failed at transport layer (curl_exit=${curl_exit})"
      sleep 2
      continue
    fi

    if [[ "${require_deepseek}" =~ ^(1|true|yes)$ ]]; then
      local policy_reason

import json
import os
import sys

with open(os.environ["RESEARCH_JSON"], "r", encoding="utf-8") as file_obj:
    research = json.load(file_obj)

mode = os.environ["RESEARCH_MODE"]
context_debug = research.get("context_debug")
if not isinstance(context_debug, dict):
    context_debug = {}
used_stages = set(context_debug.get("used_stages") or [])
fallback_used = bool(research.get("fallback_used"))

if "llm_generation" not in used_stages:
    print(f"{mode}: llm_generation stage not present")
    sys.exit(1)
if fallback_used:
    print(f"{mode}: fallback_used=true")
    sys.exit(1)
PY
      )"; then
        policy_reason="${policy_reason//$'\n'/; }"
        if [[ -z "${policy_reason}" ]]; then
          policy_reason="${research_mode}: deepseek policy check failed"
        fi
        last_reason="deepseek_policy_violation (${policy_reason})"
        echo "[smoke] ${research_mode} attempt ${attempt} failed deepseek policy: ${policy_reason}; retrying..."

      fi
    fi

    SMOKE_RESEARCH_FAIL_REASON=""

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="${1:-/opt/clara-care}"

SKIP_BUILD="${SKIP_BUILD:-false}"
SKIP_ENV_GUARD="${SKIP_ENV_GUARD:-false}"

ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE=""

if [[ ! -d "${ROOT_DIR}" ]]; then

  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
  echo "[deploy] env file not found: ${ENV_FILE}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
  ml_key_line="$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY=' "${ENV_FILE}" | tail -n 1 || true)"
  if [[ -n "${ml_key_line}" ]]; then
    ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE="${ml_key_line#*=}"
    ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE="${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE%\"}"
    ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE="${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE#\"}"
    ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE="${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE%\'}"
    ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE="${ML_INTERNAL_API_KEY_VALUE#\'}"
  fi
  csrf_cookie_line="$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME=' "${ENV_FILE}" | tail -n 1 || true)"
  if [[ -n "${csrf_cookie_line}" ]]; then
    AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE="${csrf_cookie_line#*=}"
    AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE="${AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE%\"}"
    AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE="${AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE#\"}"
    AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE="${AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE%\'}"
    AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE="${AUTH_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME_VALUE#\'}"
  fi
fi

if [[ "${SKIP_ENV_GUARD}" != "true" ]]; then
  if [[ -x "${ENV_GUARD_SCRIPT}" ]]; then
    REQUIRE_DEEPSEEK="${REQUIRE_DEEPSEEK}" "${ENV_GUARD_SCRIPT}" "${ENV_FILE}"
  else
    echo "[deploy] warn: env guard script not found or not executable: ${ENV_GUARD_SCRIPT}" >&2
  fi
fi

  docker compose
  --env-file "${ENV_FILE}"

  -f "${ROOT_DIR}/deploy/docker/docker-compose.app.yml"
)

bridge_api_to_postgres_network() {
  local postgres_container="${POSTGRES_CONTAINER_NAME:-clara-postgres}"
  local api_container_id
  local postgres_container_id
  local network

  api_container_id="$("${COMPOSE[@]}" ps -q api 2>/dev/null || true)"
  postgres_container_id="$(docker ps -q -f "name=^/${postgres_container}$" 2>/dev/null || true)"

  if [[ -z "${api_container_id}" || -z "${postgres_container_id}" ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  while IFS= read -r network; do
    [[ -z "${network}" ]] && continue
    docker network connect "${network}" "${api_container_id}" 2>/dev/null || true
  done < <(docker inspect -f '{{range $k, $v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "${postgres_container_id}")
}

wait_json() {
  local url="$1"
  local pattern="$2"
  local attempts="${3:-20}"
  local sleep_seconds="${4:-2}"

  for ((i=1; i<=attempts; i++)); do
    if output="$(curl -fsSL "${url}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
      if [[ "${output}" == *"${pattern}"* ]]; then
        echo "[health] ok ${url}"
        return 0
      fi
    fi
    echo "[health] waiting ${url} (${i}/${attempts})"
    sleep "${sleep_seconds}"
  done

  echo "[health] failed ${url} did not contain pattern: ${pattern}" >&2
  return 1
}

name: CD

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      image_tag:
        description: "Image tag to deploy (vX.Y.Z or sha-<shortsha>)"
        required: true
        type: string
      promote_to_production:
        description: "Promote to production after staging smoke passes"
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean
      deployment_reason:
        description: "Release note or incident ticket id"
        required: false
        default: "manual-release"
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: read

concurrency:
  group: cd-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: "true"

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: preflight image checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      image_tag: ${{ steps.ctx.outputs.image_tag }}
      registry_repo: ${{ steps.ctx.outputs.registry_repo }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Resolve deploy context
        id: ctx
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image_tag="${{ github.event.inputs.image_tag }}"
          registry_repo="ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY,,}"
          echo "image_tag=$image_tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "registry_repo=$registry_repo" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          {
            echo "### CD Preflight"
            echo "- image_tag: \`$image_tag\`"
            echo "- registry_repo: \`$registry_repo\`"
            echo "- reason: \`${{ github.event.inputs.deployment_reason }}\`"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Login GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify release images exist
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image_tag="${{ steps.ctx.outputs.image_tag }}"
          repo="${{ steps.ctx.outputs.registry_repo }}"
          for svc in api ml web; do
            image="${repo}/clara-${svc}:${image_tag}"
            echo "Checking image: ${image}"
            docker manifest inspect "${image}" >/dev/null
          done

  deploy-staging:
    name: deploy staging + smoke
    needs: preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment:
      name: staging
    env:
      IMAGE_TAG: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.image_tag }}
      REGISTRY_REPO: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.registry_repo }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Login GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Prepare env
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_ENV_FILE }}" ]; then
            echo "[error] DEPLOY_ENV_FILE secret is required for staging deployments"
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_ENV_FILE }}" > .env
          {
            echo "API_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-api:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "ML_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-ml:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "WEB_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-web:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            # Requirement 6.6: do NOT force the implicit SQLite database fallback.
            # The deploy stack defaults DATABASE_FALLBACK_ENABLED to false; any
            # fallback is an explicit, documented opt-in supplied deliberately via
            # the DEPLOY_ENV_FILE secret (written to .env above).
          } >> .env

      - name: Pull and deploy staging stack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          retry_cmd() {
            local max_attempts="$1"
            shift
            local attempt=1
            until "$@"; do
              if [ "$attempt" -ge "$max_attempts" ]; then
                echo "[error] command failed after ${max_attempts} attempts: $*"
                return 1
              fi
              echo "[warn] command failed (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}): $*"
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done
            return 0
          }

          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml config >/dev/null
          retry_cmd 3 docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml pull
          retry_cmd 3 docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml up -d

      - name: Run staging smoke checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          wait_http() {
            local url="$1"
            local name="$2"
            local attempts=20
            local i=1
            while [ "$i" -le "$attempts" ]; do
              if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$url" >/tmp/"$name".json 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "[ok] ${name} ready at ${url}"
                return 0
              fi
              echo "[wait] ${name} not ready (${i}/${attempts})"
              sleep 3
              i=$((i + 1))
            done
            echo "[error] ${name} did not become ready: ${url}"
            return 1
          }

          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_API_PORT:-8100}/health" "api-root-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_API_PORT:-8100}/api/v1/health" "api-v1-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_ML_PORT:-8110}/health" "ml-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/" "web-home"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research" "web-research"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/deepdive" "web-research-deepdive"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/analyze" "web-research-analyze"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/citations" "web-research-citations"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/details" "web-research-details"

      - name: Capture staging compose status
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml ps > /tmp/cd-staging-ps.txt || true

      - name: Upload staging smoke responses
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: staging-smoke-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            /tmp/*health*.json
            /tmp/web-*.json
            /tmp/cd-staging-ps.txt
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Upload staging logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml logs --no-color > /tmp/cd-staging.log || true

      - name: Upload staging log artifact
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: cd-staging-logs-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/cd-staging.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  promote-production:
    name: manual promote production + smoke
    needs: [preflight, deploy-staging]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    if: ${{ github.event.inputs.promote_to_production == 'true' }}
    environment:
      name: production
    env:
      IMAGE_TAG: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.image_tag }}
      REGISTRY_REPO: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.registry_repo }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Login GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Prepare env
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_ENV_FILE }}" ]; then
            echo "[error] DEPLOY_ENV_FILE secret is required for production deployments"
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_ENV_FILE }}" > .env
          {
            echo "API_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-api:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "ML_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-ml:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "WEB_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-web:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            # Requirement 6.6: do NOT force the implicit SQLite database fallback
            # in production. The deploy stack defaults DATABASE_FALLBACK_ENABLED to
            # false and the in-code guard refuses implicit production fallback; any

            echo "[error] DEPLOY_ENV_FILE secret is required for production deployments"
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_ENV_FILE }}" > .env
          {
            echo "API_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-api:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "ML_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-ml:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "ASR_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-asr:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            echo "WEB_IMAGE=${REGISTRY_REPO}/clara-web:${IMAGE_TAG}"
            # Requirement 6.6: do NOT force the implicit SQLite database fallback
            # in production. The deploy stack defaults DATABASE_FALLBACK_ENABLED to
            # false and the in-code guard refuses implicit production fallback; any
            # fallback must be an explicit, documented opt-in supplied deliberately
            # via the DEPLOY_ENV_FILE secret (written to .env above).
          } >> .env

      - name: Set up Python for migration checks
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"

      - name: Verify target migrations define a downgrade
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Requirement 9.3 / design Property 23: every migration to be deployed
          # must define a downgrade() so a failed migration can be rolled back
          # (see docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md "Pre-migration backup & rollback").
          # Static, dependency-free gate — fails the deploy if any migration lacks
          # a downgrade(). Runs before any image is pulled or alembic upgrade runs.
          python scripts/ops/check_migration_downgrade.py services/api/alembic/versions

      - name: Pre-migration database backup
        env:
          CLARA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER: ${{ vars.CLARA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER || 'clara-postgres' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Requirement 9.3 / 9.5 + docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md ("Postgres
          # (primary)" and "Pre-migration backup & rollback"): take and verify a
          # fresh Postgres backup BEFORE the new stack starts and runs
          # `alembic upgrade head`. A failed migration rolls back to the prior
          # image and, if needed, this pre-migration backup.
          #
          # Credentials are sourced only from the secret-store-injected .env
          # (never printed); the dump is written off the repo tree.
          set -a
          # shellcheck disable=SC1091
          . ./.env
          set +a

          container="${CLARA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER}"
          backup_dir="${PRE_MIGRATION_BACKUP_DIR:-/opt/clara-care/backups/pre-migration}"
          ts="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
          dump="${backup_dir}/pg_clara_${ts}.dump"

          if ! docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "${container}"; then
            echo "[info] postgres container '${container}' is not running — no existing"
            echo "[info] database to back up (initial deploy). Skipping pre-migration backup."
            exit 0
          fi

          mkdir -p "${backup_dir}"
          chmod 700 "${backup_dir}" || true

          echo "[backup] dumping database from container '${container}' to ${dump}"
          # Consistent custom-format logical dump (includes alembic_version), per
          # the runbook's Postgres backup procedure.
          docker exec "${container}" pg_dump -U "${POSTGRES_USER}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB}" -Fc \
            > "${dump}"

          # Integrity: checksum + non-empty assertion (a bad/empty backup fails the deploy).
          sha256sum "${dump}" > "${dump}.sha256"
          ( cd "${backup_dir}" && sha256sum -c "$(basename "${dump}").sha256" )
          if [ ! -s "${dump}" ]; then
            echo "[error] pre-migration backup is empty: ${dump}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          chmod 600 "${dump}" "${dump}.sha256" || true

          echo "[ok] verified pre-migration backup: ${dump}"
          {
            echo "### Pre-migration backup"
            echo "- container: \`${container}\`"
            echo "- artifact: \`${dump}\`"
            echo "- target image tag: \`${IMAGE_TAG}\`"
            echo "- rollback: redeploy prior image; if needed restore this backup (see docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md)"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Pull and deploy production stack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          retry_cmd() {
            local max_attempts="$1"
            shift
            local attempt=1
            until "$@"; do
              if [ "$attempt" -ge "$max_attempts" ]; then
                echo "[error] command failed after ${max_attempts} attempts: $*"
                return 1
              fi
              echo "[warn] command failed (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}): $*"
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done
            return 0
          }

          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml config >/dev/null
          retry_cmd 3 docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml pull
          retry_cmd 3 docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml up -d

      - name: Apply production database migrations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The verified backup above is the rollback boundary. The migration
          # runs from the just-deployed API image before shallow health checks.
          compose=(docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml)
          "${compose[@]}" exec -T api alembic upgrade head
          "${compose[@]}" exec -T api alembic current

      - name: Apply production database migrations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The verified backup above is the rollback boundary. The migration
          # runs from the just-deployed API image before shallow health checks.
          compose=(docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml)
          "${compose[@]}" exec -T api alembic upgrade head
          "${compose[@]}" exec -T api alembic current

      - name: Run production smoke checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          wait_http() {
            local url="$1"
            local name="$2"
            local attempts=60
            local i=1
            while [ "$i" -le "$attempts" ]; do
              if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$url" >/tmp/"$name".json 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "[ok] ${name} ready at ${url}"
                return 0
              fi
              echo "[wait] ${name} not ready (${i}/${attempts})"
              sleep 3
              i=$((i + 1))
            done
            echo "[error] ${name} did not become ready: ${url}"
            return 1
          }

          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_API_PORT:-8100}/health" "prod-api-root-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_API_PORT:-8100}/api/v1/health" "prod-api-v1-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_ML_PORT:-8110}/health" "prod-ml-health"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_ASR_PORT:-8190}/ready" "prod-asr-ready"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/" "prod-web-home"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research" "prod-web-research"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/deepdive" "prod-web-research-deepdive"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/analyze" "prod-web-research-analyze"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/citations" "prod-web-research-citations"
          wait_http "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_WEB_PORT:-3100}/research/details" "prod-web-research-details"

      - name: Capture production compose status
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml ps > /tmp/cd-production-ps.txt || true

      - name: Upload production smoke responses
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: production-smoke-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            /tmp/prod-*.json
            /tmp/cd-production-ps.txt
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Upload production logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.deploy.yml logs --no-color > /tmp/cd-production.log || true

      - name: Upload production log artifact
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: cd-production-logs-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/cd-production.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

bridge_api_to_postgres_network() {
  local postgres_container="${POSTGRES_CONTAINER_NAME:-clara-postgres}"
  local api_container_id
  local postgres_container_id
  local network

  api_container_id="$("${COMPOSE[@]}" ps -q api 2>/dev/null || true)"
  postgres_container_id="$(docker ps -q -f "name=^/${postgres_container}$" 2>/dev/null || true)"

  if [[ -z "${api_container_id}" || -z "${postgres_container_id}" ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  while IFS= read -r network; do
    [[ -z "${network}" ]] && continue
    docker network connect "${network}" "${api_container_id}" 2>/dev/null || true
  done < <(docker inspect -f '{{range $k, $v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "${postgres_container_id}")
}

wait_json() {
  local url="$1"
  local pattern="$2"
  local attempts="${3:-20}"
  local sleep_seconds="${4:-2}"

  for ((i=1; i<=attempts; i++)); do
    if output="$(curl -fsSL "${url}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
      if [[ "${output}" == *"${pattern}"* ]]; then
        echo "[health] ok ${url}"
        return 0
      fi
    fi
    echo "[health] waiting ${url} (${i}/${attempts})"
    sleep "${sleep_seconds}"
  done

  echo "[health] failed ${url} did not contain pattern: ${pattern}" >&2
  return 1
}

if not login_payload.get("refresh_token"):

if not me_payload.get("subject"):
    errors.append("auth/me did not resolve subject via cookie")
if not refresh_payload.get("access_token"):
    errors.append("refresh without body token did not issue access_token")

if errors:
    print("[smoke-auth] FAILED")

        print(f"- {item}")

print("[smoke-auth] OK")

  ]);

  console.log(`console_errors=${consoleErrors.length}`);
  if(consoleErrors.length) console.log(consoleErrors.slice(0,20).join('\n'));

_DOSAGE_UNIT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\b\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s*(mg|g|mcg|μg|ml|iu|%)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_DOSAGE_COUNT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\bx\s*\d+\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_ROUTE_FORM_TOKENS = {
    "tablet",
